title: Visibility-Aware Reference Generation for Benchmarking Visual 3D Reconstruction in Vegetation-Rich Environments
abstract: Reliable evaluation of visual 3D reconstruction and depth estimation in vegetation-rich outdoor environments is limited by the scarcity of geometric ground-truth data and the cost of complete scanner surveys. We present a LiDARbased reference-generation pipeline for evaluating the zero-shot performance of feed-forward visual-geometry models alongside conventional structure-from-motion (SfM) methods. The pipeline reuses camera images, LiDAR scans, and reference poses from existing multi-sensor localization datasets to generate per-view depth maps and visible reference point clouds. To address visibility errors in accumulated LiDAR scans, we introduce the LargeDepth-Gap Visibility Score (LDGVS) for point-wise visibility filtering and automatic scale selection in Hidden Point Removal(HPR). Experiments on TartanAirV2 and TartanGround show that, compared with Poisson surface reconstruction, which is an approach suited to completed scan surveys, the combined HPR and LDGVS filtering retains approximately three times the point density at comparable absolute relative error. We also apply the pipeline to the BotanicGarden dataset to systematically compare depth estimation and 3D reconstruction methods. Feedforward methods produce dense depth predictions efficiently, but their 3D reconstructions can contain duplicated structures. Conventional SfM generally produces more coherent geometry, but its reconstructions remain sparse and more prone to failure in challenging vegetated scenes. The benchmark toolkit and datasets will be released.
tldr: 提出基于LiDAR的可见性感知参考生成流程，用于植被场景下视觉3D重建与深度估计的零样本评测。
motivation: 植被丰富的室外环境中几何真值稀缺且完整扫描调查成本高，导致视觉3D重建与深度估计缺乏可靠评测。本文旨在构建可复用的参考生成流程，以支持前馈视觉几何模型和传统SfM方法的零样本性能评估。
method: 该流程复用现有多传感器定位数据集中的相机图像、LiDAR扫描和参考位姿，生成逐视角深度图与可见参考点云。针对累积LiDAR扫描中的可见性误差，提出LargeDepth-Gap Visibility Score（LDGVS）进行逐点可见性过滤，并在Hidden Point Removal（HPR）中自动选择尺度。
result: 在TartanAirV2和TartanGround上，与适用于完整扫描调查的Poisson表面重建相比，HPR与LDGVS联合过滤在可比绝对相对误差下保留约三倍点密度。在BotanicGarden上系统比较显示，前馈方法能高效生成稠密深度预测但3D重建可能出现重复结构，传统SfM几何更连贯但重建稀疏且更易在复杂植被场景失败。
conclusion: 工作提供了面向植被环境的可见性感知基准参考生成方案，并将在发布基准工具包与数据集后促进视觉3D重建和深度估计的可复现评测。

title: GSCV++: Lightweight 3D Gaussian Splatting Sequence Compression via Standard Video Codecs
abstract: This paper presents GSCV++, a lightweight pipeline for 3D {G}aussian {S}platting (GS) sequences {C}ompression with standard {V}ideo codecs. To meet the requirements of low-complexity and hardware compatibility from the industry, GSCV++ jointly improves preprocessing, 3D-to-2D mapping, and practical video compression configuration of GS compression. First, for preprocessing, energy-adaptive inter-frame spherical harmonic (SH) alternative current (AC) dimensionality reduction (EA-SHDR) is proposed to produces a compact and stable temporal SH AC feature space. It can reduce the data volume of following mapping and practical compression, as well as less complexity while eliminating redundant information. Second, for 3D-to-2D mapping, prior-based Inter-MiniPLAS (P-MiniPLAS) is designed to generate smooth 2D feature maps through prior-based weighting factor inference and small scale remapping. Compared with vanilla Parallel Linear Assignment Sorting (PLAS) and Morton scan, P-MiniPLAS ensures the generated 2D maps are more suitable for the video codec while maintaining a low level of computational complexity. Third, for practical compression, content-aware generalized compression (CA-GC) is developed to use a non-uniform bit-depth split for coordinate map generation, and a coding unit size selection is introduced for efficient compression complexity control, which fully exploits the performance of video codecs without involving normative changes. Experiments demonstrate that GSCV++ reports over 20\% in intra- and 60\% in inter-prediction rate-distortion gains compared with state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. GSCV++ also achieves faster 2D map generation, encoding, and decoding than other SOTA methods using the same type of video codecs. Ablation studies verify the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed modules and provide insights for subsequent research.
tldr: GSCV++ 通过预处理、3D-to-2D 映射和视频编码配置联合优化，实现轻量且兼容标准视频编解码器的 3DGS 序列压缩。
motivation: 针对工业界对低复杂度与硬件兼容性的需求，GSCV++ 旨在利用标准视频编解码器高效压缩 3D Gaussian Splatting 序列，并解决现有流程在预处理、3D-to-2D 映射和实际编码配置上的效率与适配问题。
method: 方法包括：EA-SHDR 对帧间球谐 AC 特征进行能量自适应降维，构建紧凑稳定的时序特征空间；P-MiniPLAS 通过先验加权与小尺度重映射生成更适合视频编码的平滑 2D 特征图；CA-GC 采用非均匀位深划分生成坐标图，并引入编码单元尺寸选择以控制复杂度。
result: 实验表明，相较 SOTA 方法，GSCV++ 在帧内和帧间预测分别取得超过 20% 和 60% 的率失真增益；在使用同类视频编解码器时，其 2D 图生成、编码和解码速度也更快，消融实验验证了各模块的有效性与鲁棒性。
conclusion: GSCV++ 在无需修改视频编码标准的前提下，实现了轻量、硬件友好的 3DGS 序列压缩，并在率失真性能与计算效率上优于现有方法，为后续 3DGS 压缩研究提供了可复用的模块设计与实践见解。

title: Sparse Anchors for Visual Multi-Session Registration in Changing Environments
abstract: Repeated robotic monitoring requires localization across visits to the same environment, even if the environment changes. Such changes can substantially reduce persistent visual content, and repetitive structures can lead to incorrect cross-session correspondences. In this paper, we address visual multi-session registration of a new data recording (the query session) to a previously reconstructed reference map. Under substantial visual and structural changes, cross-session localization may be possible only for parts of the trajectory. In our approach, we therefore rely on a sparse set of reliable absolute pose constraints and combine them with within-session relative-pose information to register the complete trajectory to the reference map. We first estimate absolute alignment hypotheses through visual place recognition, local feature matching, and geometric verification. We then use sequence consensus to reject hypotheses that are inconsistent with a common query-to-reference alignment and retain the remaining poses as absolute anchors. These anchors are refined through featuremetric alignment against a Gaussian feature field and combined with within-session relative-pose constraints in a robust pose-graph optimization. We evaluate our approach on 15 cross-session experiments from the challenging HILTI26 construction-site dataset, covering substantial scene changes and difficult-to-match environments. Our method achieves 94.4% recall within 1m and 100.0% within 5m, outperforming independent image localization, which peaks at 65.3% and 70.7%, respectively, as well as direct registration of independently reconstructed Structure-from-Motion geometry. Our results show that sparse, reliable absolute anchors can provide accurate and complete trajectory registration even when reliable cross-session correspondences are available only for part of the query session.
tldr: 提出稀疏可靠绝对锚点结合会话内相对位姿约束，实现变化环境下的多会话轨迹配准。
motivation: 重复机器人监测需要在同一环境多次访问间进行定位，但场景变化会显著减少持久视觉内容，重复结构还会导致跨会话错误对应。论文旨在解决视觉与结构变化显著时，将新查询会话轨迹配准到已有参考地图的多会话配准问题。
method: 先通过视觉位置识别、局部特征匹配和几何验证生成绝对对齐假设，利用序列一致性剔除不符合共同查询-参考对齐的假设，保留可靠位姿作为绝对锚点。锚点通过高斯特征场上的featuremetric对齐进行细化，并与会话内相对位姿约束结合，在鲁棒位姿图优化中完成完整轨迹配准。
result: 在HILTI26建筑工地数据集的15个跨会话实验中，方法在1m内达到94.4%召回率、5m内达到100.0%，优于独立图像定位的65.3%和70.7%，也优于独立重建SfM几何的直接配准。
conclusion: 结果表明，即使可靠跨会话对应仅覆盖查询会话的一部分，稀疏且可靠的绝对锚点仍可提供准确完整的轨迹配准，为变化环境下的多会话视觉定位提供了有效方案。

title: iMED: A Multi-Endoscope Dataset for Surgical 3D Perception
abstract: We introduce iMED, the first synchronized multi-endoscope dataset for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS), designed to address a fundamental limitation in surgical vision benchmarking: the absence of independent held-out viewpoints. Existing surgical datasets capture single-trajectory sequences from a single endoscope, making it impossible to distinguish geometric generalization from photometric interpolation along a narrow forward-facing path. iMED provides 340 sequences ~170K synchronized timepoints with 4 views per timepoint) recorded simultaneously from two independent stereo endoscopes across ex vivo, postmortem, and live surgical settings, spanning 14 specimens with diverse anatomical regions and motion regimes. The dataset includes calibrated camera intrinsics, ArUco-based frame-wise pose estimates with uncertainty quantification, instrument segmentation masks, and rich clinical metadata. Using a train-on-one-endoscope, test-on-another evaluation protocol, we benchmark 23 state-of-the-art methods across rigid and deformable novel view synthesis, pose estimation, feature matching, and monocular depth estimation. Our experiments show that methods relying primarily on photometric supervision degrade substantially under this held-out-endoscope setting, while methods with explicit geometric regularization are more robust across views in our benchmark. Notably, large-scale foundation models transfer surprisingly well to surgical imagery, often outperforming domain-specific models, suggesting pitfalls in current fine-tuning protocols. iMED establishes a new evaluation protocol for geometric generalization in surgical vision.
tldr: 提出首个同步多内窥镜手术数据集iMED，含双立体视角，并建立跨内窥镜几何泛化评测基准。
motivation: 现有手术视觉数据集多来自单内窥镜单轨迹，缺乏独立留出视角，难以区分几何泛化与沿前向窄路径的光度插值。iMED旨在解决这一评测缺陷，为机器人辅助微创手术的3D感知提供多视角基准。
method: 数据集包含340个序列、约170K同步时间点，每个时间点4视角，由两个独立立体内窥镜在离体、尸检和活体场景下同步采集，覆盖14个标本及多样解剖区域与运动模式。提供标定相机内参、基于ArUco的逐帧位姿及不确定性、器械分割掩码和临床元数据；采用单内窥镜训练、另一内窥镜测试协议，评测23种SOTA方法在刚体/非刚体新视角合成、位姿估计、特征匹配和单目深度估计上的表现。
result: 实验表明，主要依赖光度监督的方法在留出内窥镜设置下性能显著下降，而具有显式几何正则化的方法跨视角更鲁棒。大规模基础模型迁移到手术图像上表现意外地好，常优于领域专用模型，提示当前微调协议可能存在问题。
conclusion: iMED为手术视觉中的几何泛化建立了新的评测协议，揭示了光度监督方法的局限和基础模型迁移的潜力，有望推动更鲁棒的手术3D感知方法发展。

title: Phase-DGS: Phase-guided Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from Unsynchronized Multi-view Video
abstract: Spatiotemporal scene reconstruction with Dynamic Gaussian Splatting (DGS) fundamentally depends on perfect temporal synchronization across all cameras, an assumption rarely achievable in practice. Industry-standard synchronization requires expensive specialized hardware and complex setup, while data-driven alternatives including audio-based alignment, geometry matching, and pose tracking remain limited by restrictive environmental or scene-specific assumptions. To overcome these limitations, we propose Phase-DGS, a framework that replaces conventional timestamps with a semantic phase representing each frame's inherent state within the underlying motion cycle. Frames capturing the same motion state share the same phase regardless of which camera records them or when, naturally establishing spatiotemporal correspondence across unsynchronized cameras. We validate Phase-DGS under temporal offsets, frame drops, and camera freezes, achieving up to +8.5 dB PSNR improvement over baselines while enabling seamless integration with existing DGS backbones including RealTime-4DGS and FreeTimeGS.
tldr: Phase-DGS利用语义相位替代时间戳，实现无同步多视角视频的动态高斯重建。
motivation: 动态高斯泼溅的时空重建依赖所有相机完美时间同步，但实际中专业硬件昂贵且音频对齐、几何匹配、位姿跟踪等数据驱动方法受环境或场景假设限制。本文旨在消除对同步时间戳和专用硬件的依赖。
method: 提出 Phase-DGS，用表示每帧在运动周期中固有状态的语义相位替代传统时间戳；同一运动状态的不同相机帧共享相位，从而在非同步相机间自然建立时空对应。该方法可无缝集成到 RealTime-4DGS、FreeTimeGS 等现有 DGS 主干。
result: 在时间偏移、丢帧和相机冻结条件下验证，PSNR 较基线最高提升 8.5 dB，并可与 RealTime-4DGS 和 FreeTimeGS 无缝集成。
conclusion: Phase-DGS 将同步问题转化为运动相位对应，提升了非同步多视角动态重建的鲁棒性与精度，并具备作为现有 DGS 框架通用插件的潜力。

title: 3DGS-VBench+ and 3DGSV-Assessor: A Multi-Dimensional Subjective Benchmark and a Reference-Flexible Objective Model for 3D Gaussian Splatting Video Quality Assessment
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel view synthesis (NVS), but its heavy storage makes compression essential, and both training and compression introduce representation-specific distortions. Since generative compression in many methods treats geometric and color attributes via different parameters, it can induce dimension-specific distortions, motivating multi-dimensional assessment. Moreover, real-world captures generally lack an aligned ground-truth video for a synthesized, continuous camera trajectory, leaving only sparse captured views as references. To enable multi-dimensional quality assessment of 3DGS videos with scarce aligned references, we first present 3DGS-VBench+, a large-scale subjective video quality assessment (VQA) benchmark comprising 3{,}036 3DGS reconstructions, each paired with a rendered video, across 11 real-world and 22 synthetic scenes, generated by 6 representative compression algorithms at systematically designed levels and annotated with 9{,}108 MOSs covering overall, geometry, and color quality. Based on 3DGS-VBench+, we propose 3DGSV-Assessor, a reference-flexible, large multimodal framework that scores all three dimensions in one generation pass and fuses a ranking-based reference cue into the frozen regressor through a bounded gate, supporting both reduced-reference (RR) and no-reference (NR) assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art correlation with human perception on 3DGS-VBench+ and strong zero-shot generalization to other NVS benchmarks. The dataset and code will be released at https://github.com/YukeXing/3DGSV-Assessor.
tldr: 提出3DGS视频多维主观质量基准3DGS-VBench+及参考灵活的多模态客观评价模型3DGSV-Assessor。
motivation: 3DGS虽支持实时新视角合成，但存储开销大、必须压缩，训练与压缩会引入表示特定失真；生成式压缩对几何与颜色属性采用不同参数，导致维度特定失真，因此需要多维度评估。同时，真实采集场景通常缺少与合成连续相机轨迹对齐的真值视频，仅有稀疏采集视图可作参考。
method: 构建大规模主观VQA基准3DGS-VBench+，包含3,036个3DGS重建及对应渲染视频，覆盖11个真实与22个合成场景、6种代表性压缩算法及系统化设置，标注9,108个MOS（整体、几何、颜色质量）。提出3DGSV-Assessor多模态框架，一次生成同时输出三个维度分数，并通过有界门控将基于排序的参考线索融合进冻结回归器，支持缩减参考（RR）与无参考（NR）评估。
result: 在3DGS-VBench+上与人类感知的相关性达到当前最优，并对其他NVS基准表现出较强的零样本泛化能力。
conclusion: 该工作为缺乏对齐参考的3DGS视频多维质量评估提供了大规模主观基准与参考灵活的客观模型，有助于推动3DGS压缩与NVS质量评价研究。数据集与代码将开源。

title: Auditing Targetless Camera-LiDAR Extrinsic Correction before Recursive Use
abstract:
Camera-LiDAR fusion repeatedly uses an extrinsic transform in projection, association, and recursive state estimation. We study whether a targetless correction should be admitted to a downstream consumer only after separate audits of correction quality, confidence ranking, and recursive risk. Our log-disjoint protocol evaluates these stages under synthetic extrinsic drift on Argoverse 2 and treats cross-dataset and odometry experiments as bounded diagnostics.
  On 27 test-split logs, single-frame Canny alignment is harmful in the mild tier. Multi-frame alignment improves severe-tier rotation by 2.52 degrees but worsens translation by 0.177 m; its declared joint error-magnitude improvement is also negative (-0.158, 95% CI [-0.223, -0.098]), so the rotation gain is not a six-degree-of-freedom correction success. A zero-injection check moves away from the true extrinsic, and solver-disagreement AUROC on selected splits does not yield a validated nonzero-coverage risk-coverage operating point.
  In a 15-log final system role, the locked conservative policy admits no candidate and equals Raw, whereas Always-correct increases trajectory error. These results support an auditable separation of correction, confidence, and recursive contamination; they do not establish a deployable calibration gate, positive odometry or SLAM improvement, map consistency, or closed-loop safety.
tldr: 提出日志分离审计框架，分别检验无目标相机-LiDAR外参校正的质量、置信度与递归风险；旋转虽改善但平移恶化，保守门控不接纳候选。
motivation: 相机-LiDAR融合在投影、关联和递归状态估计中反复使用外参，因此需要判断无目标外参校正是否应仅在通过校正质量、置信度排序和递归风险三项独立审计后才被下游接纳，以避免有害校正进入闭环。
method: 在Argoverse 2上构造合成外参漂移，采用日志不重叠协议分阶段评估单帧/多帧对齐、零注入检查和求解器分歧AUROC，并将跨数据集与里程计实验作为有界诊断。
result: 在27条测试日志上，单帧Canny对齐在轻度漂移层有害；多帧对齐将严重层旋转改善2.52度，却使平移恶化0.177 m，声明的联合误差幅度改善为负（-0.158，95% CI [-0.223, -0.098]）。零注入检查偏离真值，求解器分歧AUROC未给出经验证的非零覆盖率风险-覆盖率工作点；在15条日志的最终系统角色中，锁定保守策略不接纳任何候选且等同Raw，而Always-correct增大轨迹误差。
conclusion: 结果支持将校正、置信度与递归污染进行可审计分离，但未建立可部署的标定门控、正向里程计/SLAM提升、地图一致性或闭环安全性。

title: IGSW: Multi-Weather Urban Scene Reconstruction with Intrinsic-Decoupled Gaussian Splatting
abstract: High-fidelity weather editing of 4D scenes can support end-to-end training and closed-loop simulation for autonomous driving. Combining generative image editing with dynamic Gaussian representations enables multi-weather scene reconstruction, but weather-edited images often contain structural distortions. Directly fitting their appearance may propagate errors from teacher images into the reconstructed 4D scene, compromising the original scene structure and temporal continuity. To address these challenges, we propose IGSW, a two-stage framework that combines intrinsic-decoupled 4D Gaussian scene modeling with structure-preserving weather refinement. In Stage I, background Gaussian appearance is decomposed into weather-shared albedo and normals and weather-specific irradiance and residuals. Weather teacher images generated by a diffusion-based image editing model and intrinsic maps estimated by a diffusion-based inverse renderer provide feature-level soft supervision for stable structure and illumination changes. In Stage II, a structure-preservation gate combines semantic conflicts with cross-weather intrinsic discrepancies to suppress unreliable teacher regions. Per-Gaussian weather transport variables and target-weather branches then strengthen the desired weather appearance over the intrinsic-decoupled scene. Experiments on nuScenes and Waymo show that IGSW achieves the highest content similarity and semantic consistency and the lowest temporal error among the compared methods, while retaining pronounced weather-dependent illumination and atmosphere. The project page is available at https://akaxi6.github.io/IGSW/ .
tldr: IGSW通过本征解耦高斯泼溅与结构保持天气细化，实现多天气城市4D场景重建。
motivation: 高保真4D场景天气编辑可支撑自动驾驶端到端训练与闭环仿真，但生成式天气编辑图像常含结构畸变，直接拟合会将教师图像误差传播到4D场景，破坏原始结构与时间连续性。
method: 提出两阶段框架：Stage I将背景高斯外观解耦为天气共享的反照率与法线及天气特定的辐照度与残差，并以扩散编辑教师图像和扩散逆渲染本征图进行特征级软监督；Stage II利用语义冲突与跨天气本征差异构建结构保持门控抑制不可靠教师区域，再通过逐高斯天气传输变量和目标天气分支增强目标天气外观。
result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上，IGSW在对比方法中取得最高的内容相似度与语义一致性以及最低的时间误差，同时保留显著的天气相关光照与大气效果；摘要未提供具体量化数值。
conclusion: IGSW通过本征解耦4D高斯建模与结构保持天气细化，在实现多天气外观编辑的同时维持场景结构与时间连续性，为自动驾驶多天气闭环仿真提供了有效方案。

title: EndoS3:Endoscopic Semantic Splatting SLAM
abstract: Purpose: Despite advances in 3D surgical scene understanding, semantic simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM) remains under-explored for two key reasons. First, it requires solving three challenging tasks in parallel: camera pose tracking, high-fidelity deformable reconstruction, and semantic mapping, making progress particularly demanding. Second, the scarcity of datasets providing the necessary ground truth to evaluate all three tasks comprehensively under conditions that closely reflect real surgical procedures environments. Method: We propose EndoS3, a Gaussian Splatting-based semantic SLAM framework that uses instance masks to guide all three tasks. An instance-level motion decomposition module separates static and dynamic instances by evaluating residual flow after compensating for camera motion, accounting for flow noise and comparing motion across neighbouring instances. The camera is tracked against the static Gaussians, while an instance-aware warp field gives each dynamic instance its own control nodes and deformation network. A semantic node allocation module redistributes a fixed node budget across instances according to their size and non-rigidity. We also introduce CRCD++, an ex-vivo Cholecystectomy dataset with RGB-D frames, camera pose and instance annotations for full semantic SLAM evaluation. Results: EndoS3 surpasses all state-of-the-art general-purpose and surgical semantic SLAM methods in tracking, reconstruction and semantic mapping on the CRCD++ and SemSup datasets. Conclusion: Semantic-aware motion and deformation modelling is vital to surgical semantic SLAM. EndoS3 and CRCD++ offer a method and benchmark for improved geometric and semantic understanding in endoscopy.
tldr: 提出基于高斯泼溅的语义SLAM框架EndoS3及CRCD++数据集，统一提升内窥镜追踪、重建与语义建图。
motivation: 内窥镜语义SLAM需并行解决相机位姿跟踪、高保真可变形重建和语义建图，且缺少能全面评估三项任务的真实手术场景数据集，导致进展受限。
method: EndoS3以实例掩码贯穿三项任务：实例级运动分解在补偿相机运动后依据残差光流并考虑噪声和邻域实例区分动静；相机对静态高斯跟踪，动态实例由带独立控制节点和变形网络的实例感知warp field建模；语义节点分配按实例尺寸与非刚性重分配固定节点预算。同时构建CRCD++离体胆囊切除RGB-D数据集，含位姿和实例标注。
result: 在CRCD++和SemSup数据集上，EndoS3在相机跟踪、重建和语义建图方面均超过现有通用及手术语义SLAM方法；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 表明语义感知的运动与变形建模对外科语义SLAM至关重要；EndoS3与CRCD++为内窥镜场景的几何与语义理解提供方法和基准。

title: Mamba3R: Fixed-Capacity Selective State Memory for Long-Sequence 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction must maintain geometric quality over long inputs within a fixed GPU budget. A pretrained recurrent model provides bounded state, but freezing its backbone also fixes its learned state-observation interactions. We introduce Mamba3R, a jointly designed state-memory adapter that provides a trainable adaptation path without updating the backbone or task heads. A selective state-space mixer jointly transforms native state features and a fixed-capacity auxiliary memory, explicit read and write paths carry information across frames, and a decomposed feedback path regulates what the added memory feeds back. Only 1.28 million adapter parameters are trained. Under a shared periodic-reset protocol, it lowers trajectory error and improves accumulated surface and depth accuracy over recurrent baselines on public indoor and outdoor datasets and robot-recorded traversals, gaining up to 40 percent on one metric. Matched comparisons support both the choice of the mixing operator and the utility of carrying the auxiliary memory across frames. Allocated memory remains unchanged and throughput moves by at most 1.4 percent from one to two thousand frames. Replaying its recorded traversals offline, the platform's RTX 4060 averages 11.7 frames per second within 5.1 GiB with the same checkpoint, a mean throughput covering the 10 Hz sensor rate.
tldr: Mamba3R 用固定容量选择性状态记忆适配器提升长序列流式三维重建，且不更新主干。
motivation: 流式三维重建需要在固定 GPU 预算下对长输入保持几何质量。预训练循环模型虽提供有界状态，但冻结主干会固定其已学到的状态-观测交互，限制适配能力。
method: 提出 Mamba3R 状态记忆适配器，在不更新主干和任务头的前提下提供可训练适配路径。选择性状态空间混合器联合变换原生状态特征与固定容量辅助记忆，显式读写路径跨帧传递信息，分解反馈路径调节辅助记忆的回馈；仅训练 128 万适配器参数。
result: 在共享周期重置协议下，于公开室内外数据集和机器人记录轨迹上降低轨迹误差并提升累积表面与深度精度，相对循环基线在某一指标上最高提升 40%。匹配实验支持混合算子选择与跨帧辅助记忆的有效性；内存分配不变，帧数从 1000 增至 2000 时吞吐变化不超过 1.4%。RTX 4060 上以同一检查点在 5.1 GiB 内平均 11.7 FPS，覆盖 10 Hz 传感器速率。
conclusion: Mamba3R 以极小适配参数和固定容量记忆实现长序列流式三维重建的稳定高效适配，在不更新主干的情况下提升几何与轨迹精度，并保持内存与吞吐稳定，具备部署于资源受限平台的潜力。

title: ReVA-HPE: Relative 6DoF Head Pose Estimation with Synthetic Pose Supervision and Personalized Virtual Anchors
abstract: Monocular head pose estimation is usually formulated as absolute regression from a single face crop, yet many applications observe the same person over time and can supply an explicit anchor image. Recently, relative head pose estimation was proposed, which casts the problem as estimation of the relative geometric change between an anchor and a query image. However, existing methods still require the anchor image pose to be known at inference, significantly limiting their practical use. We first extend relative head pose estimation to full 6DoF by additionally predicting a depth-normalized relative translation, which composes with the anchor to recover metric query pose in the camera frame. To eliminate the need for a ground-truth anchor pose, we reconstruct a personalized avatar from a single unlabeled enrollment image and render a bank of virtual anchors with known poses. The bank provides robust rotation hypotheses through multi-anchor consensus, while the real enrollment image serves as the real anchor in the translation branch via landmark PnP. We also introduce an efficient variant that amortizes the bank cost once at enrollment, after which each query requires a single real-to-real relative prediction, with limited accuracy sacrifice. The relative pose estimator is trained exclusively on synthetic face renderings, without real pose supervision, pseudo-labels, domain adaptation, or fine-tuning on the evaluation sets. On real 6DoF benchmarks, ReVA-HPE achieves state-of-the-art rotation accuracy on BIWI and, given a near-frontal enrollment image, on FaMoS, while remaining competitive in metric translation despite relying solely on synthetic pose supervision. Project page and code: https://vasilikivas.github.io/ReVA-HPE/
tldr: 提出ReVA-HPE，用单张无标注注册图构建个性化虚拟锚点，仅凭合成监督实现相对6DoF头部姿态估计。
motivation: 现有相对头部姿态估计虽利用锚点图像建模几何变化，但推理时仍需已知锚点姿态，限制实际部署；本文旨在消除该依赖并扩展到完整6DoF。
method: 从单张无标注注册图重建个性化avatar并渲染已知姿态的虚拟锚点库，通过多锚点共识获得鲁棒旋转假设；平移分支用真实注册图经landmark PnP提供真实锚点。将深度归一化相对平移与锚点组合恢复相机系度量姿态，并提出在注册时摊销虚拟锚点库成本的快速变体；相对姿态估计器仅用合成人脸渲染训练。
result: 在真实6DoF基准上，BIWI旋转精度达SOTA，FaMoS在近正脸注册图条件下也达SOTA；仅用合成位姿监督时度量平移仍具竞争力。快速变体以有限精度损失换取每次查询仅一次real-to-real相对预测，且无需真实位姿监督、伪标签、域适应或评测集微调。
conclusion: 表明个性化虚拟锚点与合成监督可免去推理时真实锚点姿态需求，推动相对6DoF头部姿态估计实用化；贡献在于6DoF扩展、虚拟锚点共识与高效变体，并为无真实位姿标注部署提供路径。

title: MoSoLoco: Monocular 3D Human Localization through Visual Latent Features and Social Context
abstract: Estimating the metric 3D position of people from a monocular camera is important for robot navigation and motion prediction. Lightweight pose-based localizers are attractive for robotic hardware with limited computational resources because they operate on compact 2D keypoints. However, they typically discard the richer visual representations computed by the pose estimator. We introduce MoSoLoco, a per-frame monocular 3D human localizer that combines the pose detector's internal visual features with the detected 2D skeleton, without requiring an additional RGB or depth encoder. MoSoLoco can further incorporate sparse same-frame multi-person context to refine individual position estimates. Experiments on JRDB and NuScenes show that reusing pose-detector representations improves localization, reducing the best JRDB error by approximately 23 percent relative to the strongest evaluated keypoint-based baseline. A sparse social-interaction module incorporates nearby detections from the same image for further refinement. Controlled trajectory-forecasting experiments show downstream benefits, while the complete pipeline remains suitable for efficient Jetson AGX Xavier inference.
tldr: MoSoLoco复用姿态检测器视觉特征与2D骨架，并融合同帧多人社交上下文，实现高效单目3D人体定位。
motivation: 现有轻量级基于姿态的单目3D人体定位器仅使用2D关键点，丢弃姿态估计器内部的丰富视觉表征，难以在有限算力机器人上兼顾精度与效率。
method: MoSoLoco逐帧将姿态检测器内部视觉特征与检测到的2D骨架结合，无需额外RGB或深度编码器；并通过稀疏同帧多人上下文模块利用邻近检测进一步修正个体位置。
result: 在JRDB和NuScenes上，复用姿态检测器表征降低了定位误差，JRDB最佳误差相对最强关键点基线约降低23%；受控轨迹预测实验显示下游收益，完整流程可在Jetson AGX Xavier上高效推理。
conclusion: 研究表明复用姿态检测器视觉潜特征并引入稀疏社交上下文可在不增加额外编码器的情况下提升单目3D人体定位，并具备机器人端高效部署潜力。

title: 3D Gaussian Splatting within Self-Learned Neural View-Dependent Color Fields
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a vital tool in novel view synthesis. 3D Gaussian functions with attributes like color, opacity, and scale are stacked together to explicitly model a radiance field. However, discrete 3D Gaussians usually produce poor depth with few geometry details but lots of floaters, which hinders the effective modeling of smooth radiance fields. To address this issue, we propose to learn a radiance field within a continuous view-dependent color field parameterized by neural networks. With continuous constraints in color, the bias on low-frequency signals of neural networks can highly encourage the geometry modeling to contribute to high-frequency color variations on images, getting rid of solely relying on the color attribute itself. Moreover, we impose a constraint to improve the Lipschitz continuity of the neural color field, making large changes of each Gaussian's color also match with large changes of its position in terms of a ratio. To this end, we additionally introduce novel self-learning strategies to improve the learning of the neural view-dependent color field without any external knowledge or priors, aiming for better generalization on unseen scenes. Our numerical and visual comparisons on widely used benchmarks justify our idea and show better ability of high fidelity geometry recovery in 3DGS. Project page: https://github.com/yangyixi21/Neural-Color-Fields-3DGS.
tldr: 提出在自学习神经视角相关颜色场中约束3DGS，以提升几何重建与高频颜色建模。
motivation: 离散3D高斯通常产生较差的深度和较少几何细节，并伴随大量浮块，阻碍平滑辐射场的有效建模。研究旨在利用连续颜色场约束改善3DGS的几何建模能力。
method: 将辐射场学习嵌入由神经网络参数化的连续视角相关颜色场，通过低频信号偏置促使几何建模贡献图像高频颜色变化；同时约束神经颜色场的Lipschitz连续性，使高斯颜色变化与位置变化按比例匹配，并引入无需外部知识或先验的自学习策略提升泛化能力。
result: 在常用基准上的数值与视觉比较验证了该方法，显示3DGS在高保真几何恢复方面具有更好能力；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该方法通过连续视角相关颜色场、Lipschitz约束和自学习策略增强3DGS的几何建模与场景泛化能力，为高质量新视角合成提供了新思路。

title: Ray-SCR: Generalizing Scene Coordinate Regression Across Camera Models
abstract:
Among visual localization strategies, scene coordinate regression (SCR) has emerged as an attractive approach for its compactness, accuracy, and speed. Despite these advantages, SCR models generalize poorly across substantially different camera models, such as omnidirectional or strongly rectified imagery. This limitation arises because, changes in field of view, lens distortion, or rectification-induced resampling can make the same scene content appear differently depending on its pixel position, degrading localization accuracy. To cope with this limitation, we introduce Ray-SCR, a lightweight extension to existing SCR architectures that conditions local visual features on their calibrated viewing rays and refines neighboring ray-conditioned features with a shallow local Transformer. We further formulate supervision directly in ray space and use sparse SfM points as metric anchors that link observations across views and camera models. Taken together, these components enable a single scene representation built from a panoramic mapping sequence to accurately localize query images captured with very different cameras, including pinhole, fisheye, and omnidirectional cameras.
  We evaluate Ray-SCR across multiple SCR architectures and on datasets with pinhole, fisheye, and omnidirectional cameras. The proposed ray conditioning substantially improves generalization across cameras and leads to state-of-the-art localization performance in these challenging cross-camera settings. The project page is available at https://jaeminch0.github.io/ray-scr-generalizing-scene-coordinate-regression-across-camera-models/.
tldr: Ray-SCR通过视射线条件化与射线空间监督，提升场景坐标回归模型跨相机模型的定位泛化能力。
motivation: 场景坐标回归（SCR）具有紧凑、准确和快速的优势，但现有SCR模型在视场角、镜头畸变或校正重采样差异较大的相机模型之间泛化较差，同一场景内容因像素位置不同而表现不一致，导致定位精度下降。
method: 提出Ray-SCR，一种对现有SCR架构的轻量扩展：将局部视觉特征条件化到标定视射线上，并用浅层局部Transformer细化相邻的射线条件特征；同时直接在射线空间构建监督，并利用稀疏SfM点作为度量锚点来关联跨视角、跨相机模型的观测。
result: 在多种SCR架构以及包含针孔、鱼眼和全向相机的数据集上评估，射线条件化显著改善了跨相机泛化，并在这些困难的跨相机设置中取得最先进定位性能；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: Ray-SCR能够基于全景建图序列构建单一场景表示，并准确本地化由针孔、鱼眼和全向等不同相机拍摄的查询图像，为跨相机模型视觉定位提供了有效方案。

title: MuCHMDPoser: Multiview RGB-Camera Full-Body Pose Tracking for Virtual Reality
abstract: Accurate full-body tracking in Virtual Reality (VR) is heavily underconstrained when relying solely on consumer-grade sparse sensors, such as Head-Mounted Displays (HMDs) and handheld controllers. Indeed, the self-avatar full-body pose must be inferred based on the 3 available upper-body joints tracked by these devices. This leads to significant tracking error, especially in lower-body pose. To overcome this issue, we propose to extend the tracking setup with external multiview RGB cameras. We show that integrating RGB-based pose estimation this framework is able to significantly decrease lower-body tracking errors, even under common artifacts in RGB-based estimates. Additionally, we evaluate a only-once HMD-camera calibration procedure that does not require any physical markers. We finally propose an implementation of the overall framework, achieving an end-to-end animation at 60 FPS on a Nvidia RTX3080 GPU. Codes are available at https://github.com/antmaio/MuCHMDPoser.
tldr: MuCHMDPoser用多视角RGB相机增强VR稀疏传感器全身追踪，降低下肢误差并实现60 FPS。
motivation: 仅依赖HMD和手柄等消费级稀疏传感器时，VR全身姿态只能由3个上身关节推断，下肢姿态严重欠约束且追踪误差大。为此需要引入外部多视角RGB相机补充观测。
method: 将多视角RGB姿态估计集成到VR全身追踪框架中，与HMD/手柄稀疏信号融合以约束全身姿态；并设计一次性、无需物理标记的HMD-相机标定流程。最终实现端到端动画系统。
result: 摘要报告该方法即使RGB估计存在常见伪影，也能显著降低下肢追踪误差；标定无需物理标记；在Nvidia RTX3080上实现60 FPS端到端动画。摘要未提供具体误差降低数值。
conclusion: 表明多视角RGB相机可有效缓解VR稀疏传感器全身追踪的欠约束问题，并提供可复现的实时实现（代码开源）。该框架对消费级VR全身动画与交互有潜在应用价值。

title: Comprehensive Evaluation of Monocular and Multi-view 3D Human Pose Estimation Models for Fitness Exercise Analysis
abstract: Three-dimensional human pose estimation has become a fundamental component of computer vision systems for sports analytics, rehabilitation, and motion understanding. Although recent deep learning approaches have achieved remarkable accuracy on standard benchmarks, their performance under realistic sports scenarios remains insufficiently studied. Furthermore, the trade-offs between recent monocular and multi-view approaches, as well as the benefits of post-processing techniques for improving temporal consistency, have not been systematically evaluated on fitness-oriented datasets. This paper evaluates recent state-of-the-art 3D human pose estimation methods on Fit3D, a dataset of synchronized multi-view recordings of a wide variety of fitness exercises with accurate ground-truth annotations. We study two recent monocular lifting approaches, TCPFormer and PoseMamba-L, and a multi-view model, MVGFormer, under a unified evaluation protocol. To investigate the influence of the input data, monocular methods are evaluated using ground-truth keypoints and detections generated by recent 2D pose estimators, RTMPose and YOLO-Pose. Additionally, we analyze the effectiveness of three temporal filters for reducing prediction jitter while preserving motion dynamics. Experimental results provide a detailed comparison of accuracy, temporal consistency, and robustness to imperfect 2D detections across the evaluated methods. Our analysis highlights the impact of detector quality on lifting-based approaches, compares transformer- and state-space-based temporal architectures, and discusses the practical trade-offs between monocular and multi-view systems for fitness motion analysis. Our results show that 2D detection quality, temporal modeling, and post-processing must be considered jointly in pose estimation pipelines for exercise analysis.
tldr: 该文在Fit3D上统一评测单目与多视图3D人体姿态估计模型，并分析2D检测质量与时序滤波的影响。
motivation: 现有深度学习3D人体姿态估计在标准基准上精度较高，但在真实健身运动场景中的表现研究不足；单目与多视图方法的权衡以及后处理对时序一致性的作用也缺乏面向健身数据的系统评测。
method: 在Fit3D多视图健身动作数据集上采用统一评测协议，评估单目提升方法TCPFormer、PoseMamba-L和多视图模型MVGFormer；单目方法分别使用真值关键点以及RTMPose、YOLO-Pose生成的2D检测结果，并分析三种时序滤波器在抑制抖动与保留运动动态之间的效果。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；实验从精度、时序一致性及对不完美2D检测的鲁棒性对方法进行详细比较，揭示2D检测器质量对提升式方法的影响，并对比Transformer与状态空间时序架构及单目和多视图系统的实际权衡。
conclusion: 研究表明，在健身动作分析的姿态估计流程中，2D检测质量、时序建模和后处理必须被联合考虑，为面向运动分析的3D人体姿态估计系统选型与优化提供了实证依据。

title: Maswao: An automatically collected, prepared, and benchmarked dataset for the South African Sign language
abstract: Recent advancements in sign language processing can be attributed to developments in both large-scale dataset collection and algorithmic complexity in areas such as pose estimation techniques, signal processing through Transformer models, and model optimization. However, only a handful of sign languages, such as the American, British, and German, from over 200 globally recognized sign languages, reap the benefits of such advancements, while the rest lag behind. In this study, we aim to address this technological disparity by proposing a framework for the automatic collection and preparation of sign language datasets, with very minimal human-labour intervention, using the South African Sign Language (SASL) as a testbed. Specifically, we automatically collect SASL video content using public resources such as news broadcasts. Additionally, we convert their accompanying audio streams into text using available Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) tools. Furthermore, we crop the sign language area in the videos and use gradient descent to locate valleys of non-motion to determine end-of-sentence points within long videos to create our weakly sentence-aligned parallel corpora -- the Maswao (Signs) dataset. Finally, we benchmark the weakly aligned dataset on the task of Sign-to-text Translation using Recurrent Neural Networks and Transformer models to compare their individual intricacies. Our results show that Transformer models proposed in the literature outperform recurrent baselines, with the best-performing Transformer achieving BLEU-1 to BLEU-4 scores of 13.78, 5.21, 2.52, and 1.54, respectively, as well as ChrF = 18.09 and ROUGE-L = 10.51. These results indicate that the task remains promising and warrants further investigations.
tldr: 提出自动采集与构建南非手语Maswao数据集，并用Transformer基准测试手语翻译。
motivation: 手语处理进展集中于少数手语，全球200多种手语中多数缺乏大规模数据；本文以SASL为试验对象，旨在降低人工依赖并缩小技术差距。
method: 利用新闻广播等公共资源自动收集SASL视频，用ASR将音频转文本，裁剪手语区域，并通过梯度下降定位非运动谷值切分句末，构建弱句子对齐平行语料Maswao；随后用RNN和Transformer进行Sign-to-text翻译基准测试。
result: 实验表明文献中的Transformer优于循环基线，最佳Transformer的BLEU-1至BLEU-4分别为13.78、5.21、2.52、1.54，ChrF=18.09，ROUGE-L=10.51。
conclusion: 结果表明该任务仍有前景且值得进一步研究；贡献在于提出低人工干预的自动数据集构建框架并基准化Maswao，为低资源手语研究提供参考。

title: Solv3R: 3D Looped Transformer as a Multi-view Solver
abstract: Classical structure-from-motion reconstruction proceeds iteratively, refining camera poses and scene geometry from a current estimate. This allows maps to easily expand without recomputing already computed views, or geometry estimates to improve as more observations are provided. Most geometric foundation models, however, predict entire geometry in a single forward pass or update a recurrent state as frames arrive sequentially, making this expansion and refinement non-trivial. We introduce Solv3R, a looped transformer that learns to continue solving multi-view geometry from its current state. Importantly, its update operator is independent of the iteration count, allowing previously refined and newly introduced views to be jointly updated regardless of how ``solved'' they are. We train the operator to preserve accurate reconstructions under continued iteration and correct inaccurate states, enabling refinement of fixed image collections and integration of new observations. Representations of solved views can also be cached once and reused as geometric context across iterations, enabling compact and efficient key-value caching. We analyze the solver dynamics and compare it with the state-of-the-art, demonstrating that a single learned solver supports offline reconstruction, incremental reconstruction, relocalization, and streaming without task-specific training or modules. The code and models will be made publicly available at https://ubc-vision.github.io/solv3r/.
tldr: Solv3R用循环Transformer学习迭代更新算子，从当前状态持续求解并精化多视图几何。
motivation: 经典SfM通过迭代精化相机位姿与场景几何，可在不重算已有视图的前提下扩展地图、并随观测增多提升几何精度；而多数几何基础模型要么单次前向预测全部几何，要么以循环状态逐帧更新，难以实现这种增量扩展与持续精化。
method: 提出Solv3R——一个循环（looped）Transformer，学习从当前估计状态继续求解多视图几何；其更新算子与迭代次数无关，因此已精化视图与新加入视图可被联合更新，不受各自“求解程度”影响。模型被训练为在持续迭代中保持已准确重建不变并纠正错误状态，同时可将已求解视图的表示缓存并跨迭代复用为几何上下文，实现紧凑高效的key-value缓存。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；作者通过分析求解器动力学并与现有最先进方法对比，表明单一学习到的求解器无需任务特定训练或专用模块，即可统一支持离线重建、增量重建、重定位与流式重建。
conclusion: 该工作把经典迭代求解思想引入几何基础模型，使重建可增量扩展、可对新观测持续精化，并以一个统一求解器覆盖多种多视图几何任务，为通用三维重建范式提供了新思路，代码与模型将公开。

title: GaussFlaw: Fine-Grained Perceptual Diagnosis for 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic novel- view synthesis with real-time rendering, yet fine-grained di- agnosis of its rendering artifacts remains challenging. These artifacts are typically spatially localized and exhibit diverse degradation patterns, making them difficult to character- ize using global quality metrics and image-level assessment benchmarks, which provide no explicit indication of where they occur or what types of artifacts they represent. To ad- dress this limitation, we introduce GaussFlaw-80K, the first large-scale dataset for fine-grained perceptual diagnosis in 3DGS. Constructed through a model-assisted human-in-the- loop pipeline, GaussFlaw-80K contains 80,049 artifact re- gions across 14,289 rendered images, each annotated with a pixel-level mask and one of eight flaw labels spanning ge- ometric, blending, and photometric degradations. These an- notations turn 3DGS artifact diagnosis into an explicit and measurable task. Building on this dataset, we propose Ge- oCritic, a geometry-guided multi-task model that integrates RGB appearance with depth-derived cues to jointly localize artifacts and classify their flaw types. Beyond evaluation, we further demonstrate the downstream benefits of fine-grained diagnosis through three complementary targeted operations: Gaussian densification, attribute correction, and outlier prun- ing. Experiments show that GeoCritic achieves an AUC-J of 0.9507 and an Acc@1 of 80.08%, while diagnosis-guided re- finement improves all reported global and crop-level metrics across diverse datasets and 3DGS backbones.
tldr: 提出GaussFlaw-80K细粒度伪影数据集与GeoCritic模型，实现3DGS伪影定位分类并指导渲染优化。
motivation: 3DGS虽能实时合成逼真新视角，但渲染伪影通常空间局部化且退化模式多样；现有全局质量指标与图像级评测无法指出伪影位置和类型，难以支撑细粒度诊断。
method: 构建GaussFlaw-80K：通过模型辅助的人机回环流程，在14,289张渲染图像中标注80,049个伪影区域，每个区域含像素级掩码及几何、混合、光度三类共八种缺陷标签。提出GeoCritic几何引导多任务模型，融合RGB外观与深度线索，联合定位伪影并分类缺陷类型；并利用诊断结果执行高斯致密化、属性校正和离群点剪枝。
result: GeoCritic取得AUC-J 0.9507、Acc@1 80.08%；诊断引导的细化在多种数据集和3DGS骨干上提升所有报告的全局与裁剪级指标。
conclusion: 该工作将3DGS伪影诊断转化为明确可度量任务，提供大规模细粒度数据集与几何引导多任务基线，并证明诊断可反哺渲染质量优化，对3DGS感知评估与修复具有潜在影响。

title: OctreeSplat: Hierarchical Octree-Guided Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has shown considerable potential for novel view synthesis (NVS) and 3D reconstruction. Feed-forward methods avoid costly per-scene optimization, but fixed image or spatial resolutions limit their ability to allocate primitives according to local complexity. We present OctreeSplat, a hierarchical octree-guided feed-forward Gaussian splatting. OctreeSplat extracts multi-view features and geometric priors from a frozen visual foundation model (VFM), constructs a hierarchical octree, and predicts densification scores. The resulting representation allocates Gaussian primitives at spatially varying densities according to local complexity. Stochastic solids volume rendering improves depth rendering, strengthens geometric supervision, and supports surface reconstruction. When camera parameters are available, an optional test-time optimization (TTO) module improves agreement between predicted and ground-truth parameters. Training updates only 76 million additional parameters and requires 35 GPU-hours. Experiments on Replica, TUM, Tanks and Temples, and DTU demonstrate competitive RGB view synthesis, depth synthesis, and surface reconstruction. OctreeSplat reduces the number of Gaussian primitives while maintaining high reconstruction quality.
tldr: OctreeSplat通过分层八叉树引导前馈高斯泼溅，按局部复杂度分配基元，在保持重建质量的同时减少高斯基元数量。
motivation: 前馈式3DGS虽免去逐场景优化，但固定图像或空间分辨率限制了高斯基元按局部复杂度分配，导致效率与质量难以兼顾。
method: 方法从冻结视觉基础模型提取多视图特征与几何先验，构建分层八叉树并预测致密化分数，从而以空间可变密度分配高斯基元；同时采用随机实体体渲染增强深度与几何监督，并可选测试时优化（TTO）校正相机参数。
result: 在Replica、TUM、Tanks and Temples和DTU上，OctreeSplat在RGB视图合成、深度合成与表面重建上取得有竞争力的结果，并在保持高质量重建的同时减少高斯基元数量；训练仅新增7600万参数、耗时35 GPU小时。
conclusion: OctreeSplat表明分层八叉树引导的前馈高斯基元分配可提升复杂场景下的重建效率与几何质量，为无需逐场景优化的3D重建与新颖视图合成提供可行路线。

title: IMUdrape: Generating Garment-Mounted Virtual IMU Data from Text through Physics-Based Cloth Simulation
abstract: Inertial sensors are moving into clothing, from sensorized sportswear to garments instrumented with hundreds of IMUs. Sewn into clothing, a sensor no longer moves rigidly with the body: loose fabric slides, twists and swings, so a garment-mounted sensor records the motion of the fabric as well as that of the body, and this extra motion differs from one garment to the next. Models for such sensors need training data recorded with the deployed garment, yet labeled data are scarce. Virtual IMU data generated from videos or text have eased this scarcity for body-attached sensors, but existing generators attach their virtual sensors rigidly to the body. We present IMUdrape, which generates garment-mounted virtual IMU data from text through physics-based cloth simulation. IMUdrape synthesizes motion from activity descriptions, reconstructs the target garment as a sewing pattern from photographs, places virtual IMUs at the deployment's real sensor positions, and simulates the garment with an intersection-free contact solver, so that every simulation yields paired garment and body signals. On four real datasets with clothing-mounted sensors, IMUdrape improves on existing virtual-data approaches for both activity recognition and full-body pose estimation. With one real subject, its data improve recognition macro-F1 by 7% to 46% over real data alone and by 2% to 11% over body-mounted virtual data from the same motion. When the garment is simulated on recorded motion, the pose error without any real training data falls by 30% to 33% relative to generated motion, and garment data remain 12% more accurate than body data. IMUdrape thus reduces the amount of real data that garment-mounted sensing requires.
tldr: IMUdrape 通过文本驱动物理布料仿真生成服装安装式虚拟 IMU 数据，提升识别与姿态估计。
motivation: 惯性传感器正被集成到衣物中，但服装安装式 IMU 会额外记录布料滑动、扭转和摆动，且随服装而异；此类模型需要与部署服装匹配的标注数据，而真实数据稀缺。现有从视频或文本生成的虚拟 IMU 数据把传感器刚性附着于身体，无法建模服装运动。
method: IMUdrape 从活动描述合成人体运动，利用照片重建目标服装的缝纫纸样，将虚拟 IMU 放置在部署时的真实传感器位置，并用无相交接触求解器进行物理布料仿真，从而为每次仿真同时输出配对的服装与身体信号。
result: 在四个带服装安装式传感器的真实数据集上，IMUdrape 在活动识别和全身姿态估计上优于现有虚拟数据方法。单名真实受试者实验中，其数据使识别 macro-F1 较仅用真实数据提升 7% 至 46%，较同一运动的身体安装式虚拟数据提升 2% 至 11%；在录制运动上仿真服装时，无真实训练数据的姿态误差相对生成运动降低 30% 至 33%，且服装数据比身体数据仍准确 12%。
conclusion: 结果表明，物理布料仿真能生成更贴近服装安装式 IMU 的虚拟数据，减少此类传感应用对真实标注数据的依赖，并凸显服装动态对识别与姿态估计的影响。

title: DUNEDepth: Bronchoscopic Depth and Pose Estimation via Hybrid Adaptation of a 3D-Vision Foundation Model
abstract: State-of-the-art bronchoscopy guidance systems and computer-aided diagnosis methods have emerged as important tools for early lung cancer detection. Effective use of these tools depends on being able to accurately link a patient's bronchoscopic airway exam video to their pre-operative 3D chest CT scan. Unfortunately, the derivation of such links, which include bronchoscope depth and camera motion, from the exam video remains an open problem. Building on recently proposed 3D-vision foundation models, we propose DUNEDepth, a hybrid architecture that combines a shared DUNE ViT encoder, a twin MASt3R cross-attention decoder structure, and a prediction head that includes elements of the MASt3R and Reloc3r models. To fine-tune the architecture to our application, we utilize an integrated hybrid synthetic-supervised/self-supervised training strategy that draws on both bronchoscopic video and CT-derived virtual bronchoscopic views. Experiments drawing on bronchoscopic video sequences demonstrate that DUNEDepth more accurately derives depth information and camera motion trajectories than previously proposed self-supervised methods.
tldr: 提出DUNEDepth，通过混合适配3D视觉基础模型从支气管镜视频估计深度与相机运动。
motivation: 支气管镜导航与计算机辅助诊断需将患者支气管镜气道检查视频与术前3D胸部CT准确关联，但仅从视频推导支气管镜深度和相机运动仍是未解决问题。研究旨在提升该关联所需深度与位姿估计的准确性。
method: DUNEDepth采用混合架构，结合共享DUNE ViT编码器、双分支MASt3R交叉注意力解码器，以及融合MASt3R与Reloc3r元素的预测头。训练上采用集成的混合合成监督/自监督策略，同时利用支气管镜视频和CT衍生虚拟支气管镜视图进行微调。
result: 在支气管镜视频序列上的实验表明，DUNEDepth推导深度信息和相机运动轨迹的精度优于先前提出的自监督方法。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作通过混合适配3D视觉基础模型，为支气管镜视频中的深度与相机位姿估计提供了更准确的方法，有助于改善支气管镜与术前CT的关联。其贡献主要体现在架构设计与合成-自监督混合训练策略，并可支持导航和计算机辅助诊断应用。

title: CoReMatch: Recurrent Continuous Coordinate Refinement for Real-Time Robotic Feature Matching
abstract: Feature matching underpins many robotic perception tasks, including visual localization, mapping, SLAM, and autonomous navigation. Existing semi-dense matchers predict confidence on fixed grids, limiting correspondences to predefined locations and requiring costly high-resolution grids for precise localization. We present CoReMatch (Coordinate Refinement Match), a recurrent framework that refines correspondences directly in continuous coordinate space rather than predicting discrete confidence maps. CoReMatch progressively improves correspondence estimates by propagating information across iterations. At the coarse stage, a Deep Aggregated Transformer captures global context and iteratively updates correspondence coordinates, while a lightweight regression head further sharpens their localization. Experiments on indoor and outdoor benchmarks show that CoReMatch strikes a strong balance between accuracy and efficiency, outperforming Efficient LoFTR in accuracy while running more than 10x faster on embedded edge hardware. These results demonstrate that recurrent coordinate refinement offers an efficient and scalable approach to real-time feature matching for robotic perception.
tldr: CoReMatch 通过循环连续坐标细化实现实时机器人特征匹配，精度超过 Efficient LoFTR，且在边缘硬件上快 10 倍以上。
motivation: 现有半稠密匹配器在固定网格上预测置信度，使对应点受限于预定义位置，若要精确定位还需高分辨率网格，计算开销大。研究旨在直接在连续坐标空间中细化对应关系，以兼顾定位精度与实时效率。
method: CoReMatch 采用循环框架，在多次迭代中传播信息并逐步更新对应坐标；粗阶段使用 Deep Aggregated Transformer 捕获全局上下文并迭代修正坐标，随后由轻量回归头进一步锐化定位。
result: 在室内和室外基准上，CoReMatch 在精度与效率之间取得强平衡，精度优于 Efficient LoFTR，同时在嵌入式边缘硬件上运行速度超过其 10 倍。
conclusion: 结果表明，循环连续坐标细化是一种高效且可扩展的实时特征匹配方案，适合机器人感知任务，并为连续空间对应估计提供了新思路。

title: Lie Routing Vision Language Models for View-Robust 3D Understanding
abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress in 3D scene understanding from multi-view RGB observations. Yet a fixed object and query can elicit inconsistent target-related responses across camera viewpoints, a phenomenon we characterize as viewpoint-induced semantic drift. We introduce LieVLM, a Lie routing framework for view-robust 3D understanding. Motivated by the rotational component of viewpoint change, Lie routing adapts visual representations by applying local $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ transformations to projected features within learned three-dimensional subspaces. Geometry tokens extracted by VGGT predict local rotation parameters and channel-wise routing coefficients. A closed-form Padé--Cayley map transforms projected visual features, whose identity-relative corrections are projected back and gated into the original visual and geometry features. This design retains the pretrained semantic and direct spatial context while learning view-dependent feature adjustments. Experiments on 3D captioning, grounding, detection, and spatial reasoning show consistent improvements over additive fusion across training scales and backbones. Controlled ablations examine the roles of geometric conditioning and transformation structure. Viewpoint analyses further reveal systematic variation in the predicted routing states alongside more localized target responses and stronger task performance across viewpoint changes.
tldr: 提出LieVLM，用SO(3)李路由对多视图特征做视角自适应变换，缓解视角导致的三维语义漂移。
motivation: 多模态大语言模型虽能基于多视角RGB进行3D场景理解，但同一物体和查询在不同相机视角下会产生不一致回答，即视角诱导语义漂移。研究旨在实现视角鲁棒的三维理解。
method: LieVLM利用VGGT提取的geometry tokens预测局部旋转参数与通道级路由系数，在学习到的三维子空间中对投影视觉特征施加局部SO(3)变换；通过闭式Padé–Cayley映射生成相对恒等的修正，再投影回并门控融合到原始视觉与几何特征中，从而保留预训练语义和直接空间上下文。
result: 在3D captioning、grounding、detection和spatial reasoning任务上，LieVLM相较additive fusion在不同训练规模和backbone上均取得一致提升；消融实验验证了几何条件与变换结构的作用。摘要未给出具体量化指标，但视角分析显示预测路由状态随视角系统性变化、目标响应更局部化且跨视角任务性能更强。
conclusion: 该工作提出Lie routing框架，将视角旋转先验以SO(3)局部变换形式注入多视图3D MLLM，在保持预训练语义与空间上下文的同时学习视角相关特征调整。其贡献在于显式建模视角变化并提升跨视角3D理解鲁棒性。

title: Learning from high-resolution 2D images to reconstruct 3D microstructures
abstract: High-resolution three-dimensional (3D) microstructure characterization remains difficult to undertake at scale because volumetric imaging at the required spatial resolution is expensive, time-consuming or destructive. In many settings, however, fine-resolution two-dimensional (2D) imaging and lower-resolution volumetric measurements are both readily available. We introduce a Privileged Cross-modal Relational Distillation (PCRD) framework that leverages fine-resolution 2D observations during training to improve specimen-specific 3D reconstruction from lower-resolution volumetric imaging alone. We demonstrate PCRD on pultruded carbon fiber-reinforced polymer composites, using scanning electron microscopy as the privileged modality and micro-CT as the inference input. The framework transfers spatial organization by matching similarity distributions defined around corresponding spatial anchors in the teacher and student representations, avoiding direct alignment of heterogeneous feature vectors. In 2D cross-sectional reconstruction, PCRD improves mAP by 1.66 percentage points over direct micro-CT training. Independent 3D validation against high-resolution synchrotron X-ray CT data shows close agreement in fiber volume fraction, diameter and local spacing. The PCRD reconstruction matches 89.97% of the reference fiber centerline length, compared with 75.08% for the interpolated low-resolution volume.
tldr: 提出PCRD框架，用高分辨率2D图像蒸馏提升低分辨率体成像的三维微结构重建。
motivation: 高分辨率三维微结构表征难以规模化开展，因为所需空间分辨率下的体成像成本高、耗时长或具有破坏性；而精细二维成像与低分辨率体测量通常更容易获得。研究旨在仅利用低分辨率体成像进行推理时，借助训练阶段的高分辨率2D观测提升特定样本的三维重建质量。
method: 提出Privileged Cross-modal Relational Distillation（PCRD）框架，以扫描电子显微镜图像作为特权模态、micro-CT作为推理输入，在教师与学生表征中围绕对应空间锚点匹配相似性分布，从而迁移空间组织关系，避免异构特征向量的直接对齐。在拉挤碳纤维增强聚合物复合材料上验证该框架。
result: 在二维截面重建中，PCRD相比直接使用micro-CT训练将mAP提升1.66个百分点。基于高分辨率同步辐射X射线CT的独立三维验证显示，纤维体积分数、直径和局部间距均接近一致；PCRD重建匹配参考纤维中心线长度的89.97%，而插值低分辨率体数据为75.08%。
conclusion: PCRD能够利用高分辨率2D图像作为训练期特权信息，改善仅依赖低分辨率体成像的样本特异性三维微结构重建，为可扩展的高分辨率微结构表征提供了有效途径。

title: Depth Anyviewpoint? Evaluating Monocular Depth Over Viewpoint Sequences
abstract: Monocular depth estimation aims to predict depth maps from single RGB images (forgoing the need for stereo camera pairs) and has seen impressive leaps in performance in recent work due to the introduction of affine-invariant losses and the use of foundation model features. These monocular depth models predict affine-invariant depth, which describes the relative positions of objects in the scene instead of absolute depth. While these models demonstrate strong performance on single image benchmarks and qualitatively consistent predictions in video, their effectiveness at preserving consistent spatial structure has been less thoroughly explored. Many potential real-world applications, such as handling video streams as input, rely on coherent three dimensional consistency in scenes. Further, anchoring relative depth predictions to a metric reference for a given scene is a key challenge for applying monocular depth models to real-world situations. We develop a novel evaluation protocol for monocular depth models using video sequences with moving camera positions to test the consistency of prediction across variation in viewpoint. We demonstrate this methodology over diverse, real-world video sequences where we are able to anchor depth model output to metric depth values using structure from motion. Our work demonstrates open challenges in the development of broadly applicable monocular depth foundation models, particularly with their ability to provide temporal consistency over long time frames. We also identify challenges in the straightforward adoption of structure-from-motion as a metric grounding tool for monocular depth estimation models.
tldr: 提出基于移动相机视频序列的单目深度评估协议，检验视点变化下的预测一致性与度量锚定难题。
motivation: 单目深度模型在单图基准上表现优异，但其仿射不变深度在视频和多视点下能否保持连贯的三维空间结构尚不清楚；实际视频流应用还需将相对深度锚定到度量尺度。
method: 作者构建新的评估协议，使用相机位置移动的真实视频序列，考察单目深度预测随视点变化的一致性，并利用 structure from motion（SfM）将模型输出锚定到度量深度。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；实验在多样真实视频上表明模型在长时程时间一致性方面仍存在开放挑战，且将 SfM 直接作为度量锚定工具也面临困难。
conclusion: 研究揭示了面向广泛应用的��目深度基础模型在跨视点一致性和度量接地方面的不足，为后续评估与改进提供了新协议和问题清单。

title: UniGS-SLAM: Monocular Gaussian SLAM with Enhanced Geometry and Open-Vocabulary Semantics
abstract: Monocular semantic SLAM aims to reconstruct scene geometry and build semantic maps from RGB observations. Existing Gaussian-based methods often attach semantic labels or features to evolving Gaussian primitives, making semantic fusion difficult to maintain and increasing reconstruction overhead. Hybrid Gaussian--voxel representations provide more stable semantic support, but often rely on RGB-D input or known poses and do not revise historical semantic evidence after geometry updates. We present UniGS-SLAM, an RGB-only framework that decouples open-vocabulary semantics from Gaussian reconstruction while preserving bidirectional interaction. Foundation priors enhance monocular depth and pose estimation, while semantic observations are fused into an independent sparse voxel map with observation provenance, enabling historical contributions to be revised as reconstruction evolves. The fused semantics further guide Gaussian filtering and local surface refinement. Experiments on Replica, ScanNet, and KITTI-360 show leading tracking, rendering, and geometric reconstruction performance among representative RGB-only methods, together with strong open-set semantic mapping on Replica and ScanNet. We also achieve a 2.37-fold reconstruction speedup over the fastest compared semantic SLAM baseline. Project page: https://3dagentworld.github.io/UniGS-SLAM/.
tldr: 提出仅RGB的UniGS-SLAM，将开放词汇语义与高斯重建解耦，并通过稀疏体素语义融合实现双向交互。
motivation: 现有基于高斯的语义SLAM通常将语义标签或特征附着在不断更新的高斯基元上，导致语义融合难以维护且重建开销增加；混合高斯-体素表示虽更稳定，但常依赖RGB-D输入或已知位姿，并且几何更新后不会修正历史语义证据。
method: UniGS-SLAM仅使用RGB输入，将开放词汇语义从高斯重建中解耦并保留双向交互；利用基础模型先验增强单目深度与位姿估计，将语义观测融合到带观测来源记录的独立稀疏体素地图中，使历史语义贡献可随重建演化被修正，并用融合语义指导高斯过滤与局部表面细化。
result: 在Replica、ScanNet和KITTI-360上的实验表明，该方法在代表性纯RGB方法中取得领先的跟踪、渲染和几何重建性能，并在Replica和ScanNet上实现较强的开放集语义建图；相比最快的对比语义SLAM基线取得2.37倍重建加速。
conclusion: 该工作通过带来源记录的解耦语义体素表示，实现了可修正的开放词汇语义融合与高效单目高斯SLAM，为仅RGB的语义建图提供了兼顾几何质量、语义稳定性和重建效率的新方案。

title: Unified Loss-Aware Density Control for 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: The efficiency and fidelity of 3D Gaussian Splatting critically depend on adaptive density control, which grows and suppresses Gaussian primitives throughout optimization. However, the standard pipeline still relies on heuristic view-space gradients, scale thresholds, and global opacity resets, rather than explicitly assessing the loss-reducing effect of each split, clone, or opacity update. This mismatch can allocate primitives to already-sufficient regions, miss under-reconstructed structures, and destabilize training through blanket opacity changes. In this work, we recast adaptive density control as a collection of local loss-reduction decisions. We derive efficient Taylor-based per-Gaussian surrogates that predict the objective change caused by three primitive-level operations: splitting, cloning, and opacity decay. This yields a unified loss-aware framework with three components. First, we extend second-order splitting to a normalized joint position-scale space, enabling children to adapt not only their locations but also their anisotropic extents. Second, we formulate duplicate cloning as a surrogate minimization problem, selecting only Gaussians whose duplicated contribution is predicted to improve reconstruction and assigning each child a principled opacity. Third, we replace global opacity reset with selective soft opacity decay that weakens harmful primitives while preserving useful ones. Across standard 3DGS benchmarks, our method produces more targeted primitive allocation and achieves improved rendering quality with comparable or smaller Gaussian budgets compared to baselines.
tldr: 将3DGS密度控制重构为局部损失下降决策，用Taylor代理统一指导分裂、克隆与透明度衰减。
motivation: 标准3DGS自适应密度控制依赖视空间梯度、尺度阈值和全局透明度重置等启发式规则，未显式评估分裂、克隆或透明度更新对损失的降低效果，导致基元被分配到已充分区域、遗漏欠重建结构，并因全局重置破坏训练稳定性。
method: 作者将自适应密度控制建模为一组局部损失下降决策，推导高效的Taylor逐高斯代理来预测分裂、克隆和透明度衰减引起的目标变化。框架包含三部分：在归一化联合位置-尺度空间扩展二阶分裂，使子基元同时调整位置与各向异性范围；将重复克隆表述为代理最小化问题，仅为预测能改善重建的基元执行克隆并分配合适的不透明度；用选择性软透明度衰减替代全局重置。
result: 在标准3DGS基准上，该方法实现更有针对性的基元分配，并在高斯预算相当或更小的条件下取得更优渲染质量；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作提出统一的损失感知密度控制框架，以可预测损失变化的代理决策替代启发式操作，提高3DGS优化效率与重建保真度。其贡献在于将分裂、克隆和透明度衰减纳入同一损失下降视角，并为更稳定、更节省基元的三维重建提供潜在方向。

title: VLSplat: Vision-Language Guided Object-Centric 3D Gaussian Splatting via Scene Graph
abstract: Learning semantic representations for 3D Gaussian Splatting has recently emerged as a promising direction for 3D scene understanding. However, existing 2D-to-3D semantic lifting approaches rely primarily on 2D segmentation supervision and lack object-level priors, causing the learned representation to be driven by local mask evidence rather than holistic object structure. In this paper, we present VLSplat, a vision-language guided approach for object-centric semantic lifting in 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our method augments mask-based lifting with object-level semantic priors derived from vision-language models and refines Gaussian representations using an object-group scene graph. The refinement is performed through two language-guided modules: intra-group refinement suppresses semantic noise within object groups, while inter-group acquisition expands object support regions by incorporating structurally relevant candidates from neighboring groups. Extensive experiments on indoor scene datasets demonstrate that VLSplat improves the semantic consistency and structural completeness of object-level categories. Our code and models are available at https://vlsplat.github.io/.
tldr: VLSplat利用视觉语言先验和对象组场景图提升3DGS对象级语义的一致性与结构完整性。
motivation: 现有2D到3D语义提升方法主要依赖2D分割监督，缺乏对象级先验，导致学习到的表示受局部掩码证据驱动，而非整体对象结构。
method: VLSplat将视觉语言模型提供的对象级语义先验引入基于掩码的提升过程，并利用对象组场景图细化高斯表示。细化通过两个语言引导模块完成：组内细化抑制对象组内的语义噪声，组间获取则从相邻组引入结构相关候选以扩展对象支持区域。
result: 在室内场景数据集上的实验表明，VLSplat提升了对象级类别的语义一致性和结构完整性；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: VLSplat通过对象级视觉语言先验与场景图细化改进了3D高斯泼溅中的对象中心语义提升，有望促进3D场景理解。代码与模型已公开于https://vlsplat.github.io/。

title: Spade-SLAM: Sparse Correspondence Anchors for Dense Self-Supervised Visual SLAM
abstract: We introduce Spade-SLAM, a self-supervised dense visual SLAM framework that substantially narrows the long-standing performance gap to supervised methods in a zero-shot setting. By demonstrating that high-fidelity tracking can be achieved without explicit ground-truth pose and depth labels, our approach offers a highly effective and label-efficient alternative to fully supervised pretraining. Our core contribution is a complementary sparse-to-dense training regime: While a warping-based photometric loss provides a dense training signal, we stabilize the optimization and suppress drift in ambiguous regions using a sparse correspondence loss derived from image feature matches. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Spade-SLAM significantly improves robustness and accuracy compared to existing self-supervised baselines, closely rivaling SLAM systems trained with explicit pose and depth supervision. The code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/JulianPSchmitt/Spade-SLAM.
tldr: 提出自监督稠密视觉SLAM框架Spade-SLAM，用稀疏对应锚点稳定稠密光度训练，在零样本下逼近监督方法。
motivation: 旨在缩小自监督稠密视觉SLAM与监督方法之间的长期性能差距，并证明无需显式真值位姿和深度标签也能实现高保真跟踪，从而提供高效且标签友好的替代方案。
method: 核心是互补的稀疏到稠密训练机制：稠密训练信号来自基于 warping 的光度损失，同时引入由图像特征匹配得到的稀疏对应损失，以稳定优化并抑制歧义区域的漂移。
result: 大量实验表明，Spade-SLAM 相比现有自监督基线显著提升了鲁棒性和精度，并接近使用显式位姿与深度监督训练的 SLAM 系统；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该方法在零样本设置下实现了无需真值位姿和深度标签的高保真跟踪，缩小了与监督方法的差距，提供了标签高效的替代方案，并计划公开代码。

title: Teleoperation System for Service Robots using Virtual Reality Headset and Pose Estimation
abstract: This paper presents a teleoperation system for service robots that integrates human pose estimation with virtual reality (VR) to enable intuitive remote control. By using the Mediapipe framework for 2D pose detection and extending it with RGB-D data from the Intel RealSense D455 camera, a comprehensive 3D human pose estimation is achieved. This data is then mapped to the robot's kinematics, allowing the operator to control the robot's movements naturally. A VR interface was developed to provide an immersive perspective, enhancing the operator's situational awareness. Real-world experiments were conducted using the CHARMIE service robot to validate the system's effectiveness in tasks involving object manipulation. While the current system successfully demonstrates the potential of VR-based teleoperation, challenges remain in accurately capturing certain joint angles (e.g., wrist yaw) and ensuring precise mapping between human and robot movements. Future work includes the integration of inertial measurement units (IMUs) for improved rotational tracking and the implementation of more advanced control algorithms. Overall, this research contributes to the development of more intuitive and effective teleoperation systems for service robots, facilitating their deployment in complex and dynamic environments. This work further introduces a novel approach to teleoperation by combining RGB-D sensing with an innovative algorithm for real-time joint angle computation using Mediapipe, enhancing the precision of human-robot motion mapping and enabling immersive control through a VR interface. These contributions represent significant advancements in the field of human-robot interaction, particularly for service robot applications.
tldr: 结合Mediapipe与RGB-D姿态估计和VR界面，实现服务机器人直观遥操作。
motivation: 旨在解决服务机器人在复杂动态环境中遥操作不够直观、操作者情境感知不足的问题，通过融合人体姿态估计与VR实现自然远程控制。
method: 采用Mediapipe进行2D人体姿态检测，并融合Intel RealSense D455的RGB-D数据扩展为3D人体姿态估计；将姿态数据映射到机器人运动学，并构建VR沉浸式界面进行控制。提出基于Mediapipe的实时关节角计算算法以提升人机运动映射精度。
result: 在CHARMIE服务机器人上开展真实环境物体操作实验，验证了系统有效性；但摘要未提供量化指标，且腕部偏航等关节角捕捉与精确映射仍存在挑战。
conclusion: 研究表明VR遥操作结合RGB-D姿态估计可提升服务机器人控制的直观性与沉浸感，为人机交互和复杂动态环境部署提供新思路；未来将引入IMU改善旋转跟踪并采用更先进控制算法。

title: UA-Depth: Uncertainty-Aware Depth Restoration for Material-Agnostic Object Manipulation
abstract: Robotic manipulation requires accurate metric depth, yet commodity RGB-D cameras often fail on non-Lambertian objects such as transparent, reflective, and translucent materials, producing holes, structured noise, and biased depth. Most restoration methods produce only a single depth map, treating noisy and reliable regions uniformly for downstream tasks while ignoring regional uncertainty. We present UA-Depth, an uncertainty-aware depth restoration framework that iteratively co-refines depth and pixel-wise uncertainty, and uses uncertainty-gated features to suppress unreliable cues for stable updates. To strengthen zero-shot behavior, UA-Depth leverages a frozen depth foundation model as a prior to initialize missing or unreliable depth, and applies two-stage MAD-weighted log-depth scale normalization to reduce outlier bias in relative-to-metric alignment. We introduce an eight-dataset zero-shot benchmark across diverse scenes, materials, and sensors. Across these benchmarks, UA-Depth achieves the best mean rank among representative baselines, with particularly strong gains on datasets dominated by transparent and reflective objects. Beyond depth metrics, we demonstrate downstream improvements in category-level 6D pose estimation and 6D grasp synthesis by exploiting the predicted uncertainty. \emph{Code, models, and data for training and evaluation will be released upon publication.}
tldr: 提出不确定性感知深度修复框架UA-Depth，迭代联合优化深度与像素级不确定性，在八个零样本基准上平均排名最优，并提升下游6D位姿估计与抓取合成。
motivation: 商品级RGB-D相机在透明、反光、半透明等非朗伯材料上常出现空洞、结构化噪声和深度偏置，难以满足机器人操作所需的精确度量深度。现有修复方法多只输出单张深度图，对噪声区域与可靠区域一视同仁，忽略区域不确定性对下游任务的影响。
method: UA-Depth迭代联合优化深度与像素级不确定性，并利用不确定性门控特征抑制不可靠线索以实现稳定更新。为增强零样本泛化，方法以冻结的深度基础模型为先验初始化缺失或不可靠深度，并采用两阶段MAD加权对数深度尺度归一化来降低相对深度到度量深度对齐中的异常值偏置；同时构建覆盖多场景、多材料、多传感器的八数据集零样本基准。
result: 在八个零样本基准上，UA-Depth在代表性基线中取得最佳平均排名，尤其在以透明和反光物体为主的数据集上提升显著。摘要未提供具体量化数值；此外，利用预测不确定性，下游类别级6D位姿估计与6D抓取合成均获得改进。
conclusion: UA-Depth通过不确定性感知的深度修复提升了非朗伯材料场景下的度量深度鲁棒性，并证明像素级不确定性可有效服务于6D位姿估计与抓取合成等下游操作任务。作者将在论文发表后公开代码、模型以及训练评估数据，有利于后续复现与机器人操作应用研究。

title: GSExplorer: Interactive World Generation with a Persistent 3D Gaussian World State
abstract: Interactive world generation requires both accurate local control and stable scene consistency over long rollouts. Existing methods improve local generation through camera or geometry conditioning and extend historical context with memory mechanisms. However, long-horizon exploration remains challenging as target-view guidance becomes incomplete and inconsistencies accumulate across repeated scene updates. We present \textbf{GSExplorer}, a generation--reconstruction framework built around a persistent 3D Gaussian world state. At each step, the current 3DGS scene provides multimodal rendering conditions for a condition-driven video generator, while camera geometry is injected through a separate Relative Ray Encoding branch. Generated videos are then fed back to a SLAM-based reconstruction backend, where inconsistency filtering prevents conflicting content from corrupting the scene and cross-chunk bundle adjustment improves spatial alignment across generation steps. We further design a data-construction pipeline that reproduces realistic 3DGS degradation during scene extrapolation, yielding 293K training pairs of degraded multimodal renderings and real target videos. GSExplorer achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods on both single-step and three-step WorldScore evaluation, with strong camera control and consistency across both settings, including a Camera Control score of 99.07 in single-step extrapolation. On 481-frame leave-and-return rollouts, it also shows strong revisit consistency, demonstrating the value of maintaining a reliable 3D world state for continued exploration.
tldr: GSExplorer 以持久 3D 高斯世界状态统一生成与重建，实现长程交互式世界生成。
motivation: 交互式世界生成需要精确的局部控制与长时序稳定的场景一致性。现有方法虽通过相机/几何条件与记忆机制改善局部生成，但长程探索中目标视角引导不完整，且重复场景更新会累积不一致。
method: 提出生成-重建框架 GSExplorer，以持久 3DGS 场景为世界状态：每步由当前 3DGS 提供多模态渲染条件给条件驱动视频生成器，并通过 Relative Ray Encoding 分支注入相机几何。生成视频反馈至基于 SLAM 的重建后端，利用不一致过滤防止冲突内容污染场景，并用跨块 bundle adjustment 提升生成步间的空间对齐；同时构建数据管线模拟外推中的真实 3DGS 退化，生成 293K 训练对。
result: 在单步与三步 WorldScore 评估中取得对比方法最佳总体性能，并保持强相机控制与一致性，单步外推 Camera Control 得分达 99.07。在 481 帧 leave-and-return rollout 中也表现出较强的重访一致性。
conclusion: 结果表明维护可靠且持久的 3D 世界状态对持续探索具有重要价值，GSExplorer 为长程交互式世界生成提供了生成与重建闭环的新思路。

title: Task-driven sparse-view planar X-ray computed tomography for axial metrology
abstract: Computational imaging can reduce the acquisition burden when the system is designed around task-relevant information rather than complete image recovery. We investigate this framework for sparse-view planar X-ray tomography (XCT) of layered objects, using measurement of the axial termination gap (ATG) of back-drilled printed-circuit-board (PCB) vias as a representative task. Instead of using 3D reconstruction, the proposed method estimates ATG directly from polychromatic projection data through a physics-based sensitivity model. A gated hierarchical estimator first fits ATG together with radiometric perturbations and selectively introduces global geometry and specimen-warp models only when a reduced chi-squared adequacy test and Bayesian information criterion justify the added degrees of freedom. The same low-dimensional perturbation model is incorporated into marginalized Fisher-information analyses, yielding task-specific conditional and calibration-aware Cram'er-Rao bounds. Numerical experiments show that, under a fixed total photon budget, task-driven metrology changes little over 12-64 views, while reconstruction-driven metrology is strongly view-dependent with much larger errors. The direct estimator also follows the expected photon-limited scaling. These results demonstrate a computational sensing strategy in which XCT acquisition, physical modeling, and inference are evaluated according to the quantitative information required by the task rather than for general-purpose volumetric image fidelity.
tldr: 提出面向轴向计量任务的稀疏视图平面X射线CT方法，直接从多色投影估计背钻PCB过孔轴向终止间隙。
motivation: 传统稀疏视图XCT以完整三维重建为目标，视图减少时图像保真度和计量精度受限；本文面向分层物体轴向终止间隙（ATG）测量这一具体任务，探索以任务相关信息为中心降低采集负担。
method: 方法不进行三维重建，而是基于物理灵敏度模型从多色投影数据直接估计ATG；采用门控分层估计器联合拟合ATG与辐射度量扰动，并仅在约简卡方充分性检验和BIC支持时引入全局几何与样品形变模型；同一低维扰动模型还用于边缘化Fisher信息分析，得到任务特定的条件与校准感知Cramér-Rao界。
result: 数值实验表明，在固定总光子预算下，任务驱动计量在12–64个视图间变化很小，而重建驱动计量强烈依赖视图数且误差大得多；直接估计器呈现预期的光子受限缩放规律。
conclusion: 结果表明可将XCT采集、物理建模与推断按任务所需定量信息而非通用体层图像保真度来评估，为稀疏视图X射线CT面向计量任务的设计提供计算感知策略。

title: AbacusGS: Gaussian Splatting without Per-Splat Sorting
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting sorts every splat by depth in every frame. Viewers that draw splats with the hardware rasterizer and sort them on the CPU, as most web and mobile viewers do, spend most of the frame time in this sort. We present AbacusGS, which stores the blending order of a 3DGS scene in the scene layout. AbacusGS groups the splats into octree boxes of at most 128 splats and stores each box in order along an axis chosen at write time. In each frame, AbacusGS sorts only the visible boxes, and one dot product per box decides whether the box is read forward or backward. A short order-aware fine-tuning converts an existing 3DGS model, and the over operator of 3DGS stays unchanged. On 13 standard scenes, AbacusGS loses 0.13 dB PSNR on average against an equally fine-tuned 3DGS model. In an OpenGL viewer that orders splats on the CPU, AbacusGS renders frames 4.5 times faster than per-splat sorting. We also present a compact format of 17 bytes per splat and a CUDA tile renderer that use the same order. The code will be released.
tldr: AbacusGS将3DGS混合顺序存入八叉树盒子，每帧只排序可见盒子，免去逐splat排序并提速4.5倍。
motivation: 3DGS每帧需按深度排序所有splat，尤其Web与移动端查看器在CPU上排序会占据大部分帧时间，成为渲染瓶颈。该工作旨在避免逐splat排序，同时保持3DGS的混合质量。
method: 将splat分组为最多128个的八叉树盒子，并在写入时沿选定轴存储盒内有序顺序；每帧仅排序可见盒子，每个盒子通过一次点积决定正序或逆序读取。通过短时顺序感知微调将现有3DGS模型转换到该布局，且保持over算子不变；还提出每splat 17字节的紧凑格式与复用同一顺序的CUDA tile渲染器。
result: 在13个标准场景上，相比同等微调的3DGS模型平均仅损失0.13 dB PSNR；在CPU排序splat的OpenGL查看器中，AbacusGS渲染帧速度是逐splat排序的4.5倍。
conclusion: AbacusGS以极小质量损失消除逐splat排序瓶颈，有利于Web与移动端高效部署3DGS；紧凑格式和CUDA渲染器进一步扩展了实用性，代码将开源。

title: Spectral-Convolutional Factorized Transformer for Joint Multipath Parameter Estimation: Applications to mmWave Positioning and Radio SLAM
abstract: Future 6G wireless networks are expected to evolve toward AI-native systems that support intelligent, environment-aware services, including positioning and mapping. Current research has already integrated AI into several aspects of communication, particularly wireless channel estimation. However, most learning-based channel estimators focus on communication-oriented objectives rather than explicitly estimating multipath parameters such as delay, angle of arrival (AoA), and angle of departure (AoD). These parameters provide essential geometric information for downstream tasks including positioning and radio simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). In this work, we propose a Spectral-Convolutional Factorized Transformer (SCFT) for joint multipath component (MPC) estimation from noisy complex channel estimates and physical beam-pair descriptors. SCFT combines local spectral convolution, permutation-equivariant beam-set attention, and a query-based Transformer decoder to detect and classify line-of-sight (LoS) and non-line-of-sight (NLoS) paths and estimate their observed delays, AoAs, and AoDs. Experiments on realistic ray-tracing data show that SCFT reduces the generalized optimal sub-pattern assignment (GOSPA) error by 13.4% compared with ResNet, the strongest competing baseline. We further demonstrate this advantage in independent snapshot positioning and radio SLAM, where SCFT reduces position RMSE by 18.5% and 65.0%, respectively, relative to ResNet. These findings highlight the importance of explicitly recovering multipath geometry, as improvements in MPC estimation can translate into substantial gains in downstream tasks.
tldr: 提出SCFT从含噪信道估计中联合估计多径时延、AoA和AoD，提升毫米波定位与Radio SLAM精度。
motivation: 现有学习型信道估计多面向通信目标，未显式恢复时延、AoA、AoD等多径几何参数，而这些参数对定位与Radio SLAM至关重要。本文旨在从含噪复数信道估计和物理波束对描述中联合估计多径分量。
method: 提出谱卷积因子化Transformer（SCFT），融合局部谱卷积、置换等变波束集注意力和基于查询的Transformer解码器，用于检测并分类LoS/NLoS路径，同时估计其观测时延、AoA和AoD。
result: 在真实射线追踪数据上，SCFT相较最强基线ResNet将GOSPA误差降低13.4%；在独立快照定位和Radio SLAM中，位置RMSE分别相对ResNet降低18.5%和65.0%。
conclusion: 结果表明显式恢复多径几何信息可显著提升下游定位与Radio SLAM性能，为AI原生6G环境感知与映射提供了有效技术路径。

title: RadPose: ISAC-based RF 3D Human Pose Estimation
abstract: Human pose estimation under adverse lighting and occlusion conditions remains challenging for camera- and LiDAR-based systems. Although mmWave radars provide robustness to illumination and occlusion, they rely on dedicated hardware and licensed spectrum, limiting scalability. In this paper, we present RadPose, a learning-based monostatic integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) framework that enables mmWave communication devices to perform 3D human pose estimation. Unlike specialized radars, RadPose leverages monostatic full-duplex operation to extract channel impulse responses (CIRs) directly from standard OFDM communication signals, generating 3D radio point clouds without additional sensing hardware. To address the sparsity and noise of RF observations, RadPose employs a cross-frame transformer-based pose inference network with semantic-guided spatial attention and target-driven temporal attention for robust spatio-temporal aggregation. It further adopts a joint-aware inverse kinematics refinement module based on graph convolution to enforce skeletal topology, bone-length consistency, and anatomical plausibility. Extensive experiments demonstrate RadPose achieves competitive accuracy compared to state-of-the-art radar-based approaches while maintaining robust performance in unseen and occluded scenarios. The dataset and source code are available at https://github.com/Geo-Chou/RadPose.
tldr: RadPose 利用单站全双工 ISAC 从 OFDM 通信信号提取 CIR 生成无线电点云，实现无需专用硬件的 3D 人体姿态估计。
motivation: 相机和 LiDAR 在不利光照与遮挡下的人体姿态估计仍具挑战；mmWave 雷达虽对光照和遮挡鲁棒，但依赖专用硬件与授权频谱，限制了可扩展性。RadPose 旨在让标准 mmWave 通信设备直接完成 3D 人体姿态估计。
method: RadPose 采用基于学习的单站 ISAC 框架，利用全双工操作从标准 OFDM 通信信号中提取 CIR，生成 3D 无线电点云而无需额外传感硬件。针对 RF 观测稀疏且含噪，它使用跨帧 Transformer 姿态推断网络，结合语义引导空间注意力和目标驱动时间注意力进行时空聚合。随后通过基于图卷积的关节感知逆运动学精化模块约束骨架拓扑、骨长一致性与解剖合理性。
result: 大量实验表明，RadPose 的精度可与当前先进的雷达方法竞争，并在未见场景和遮挡场景中保持鲁棒性能；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: RadPose 证明了利用标准 mmWave 通信设备进行 3D 人体姿态估计的可行性，避免额外传感硬件并提升可扩展性。作者公开数据集与源码，有望推动 ISAC 在人体感知与普适感知中的应用。

title: Unified Loss-Aware Density Control for 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: The efficiency and fidelity of 3D Gaussian Splatting critically depend on adaptive density control, which grows and suppresses Gaussian primitives throughout optimization. However, the standard pipeline still relies on heuristic view-space gradients, scale thresholds, and global opacity resets, rather than explicitly assessing the loss-reducing effect of each split, clone, or opacity update. This mismatch can allocate primitives to already-sufficient regions, miss under-reconstructed structures, and destabilize training through blanket opacity changes. In this work, we recast adaptive density control as a collection of local loss-reduction decisions. We derive efficient Taylor-based per-Gaussian surrogates that predict the objective change caused by three primitive-level operations: splitting, cloning, and opacity decay. This yields a unified loss-aware framework with three components. First, we extend second-order splitting to a normalized joint position-scale space, enabling children to adapt not only their locations but also their anisotropic extents. Second, we formulate duplicate cloning as a surrogate minimization problem, selecting only Gaussians whose duplicated contribution is predicted to improve reconstruction and assigning each child a principled opacity. Third, we replace global opacity reset with selective soft opacity decay that weakens harmful primitives while preserving useful ones. Across standard 3DGS benchmarks, our method produces more targeted primitive allocation and achieves improved rendering quality with comparable or smaller Gaussian budgets compared to baselines.
tldr: 将3DGS密度控制建模为局部损失下降决策，用Taylor代理指导分裂、克隆与不透明度衰减。
motivation: 标准3DGS密度控制依赖视角空间梯度、尺度阈值和全局不透明度重置等启发式规则，未显式评估每个图元操作对损失的降低效果，导致图元分配错位、漏重建结构及训练不稳定。
method: 作者将自适应密度控制转化为局部损失下降决策，推导高效的Taylor逐Gaussian代理来预测分裂、克隆和不透明度衰减引起的目标变化；并统一实现归一化联合位置-尺度空间二阶分裂、以代理最小化选择克隆并赋予子图元合理不透明度，以及选择性软不透明度衰减替代全局重置。
result: 在标准3DGS基准上，该方法实现更有针对性的图元分配，并在相当或更小的Gaussian预算下取得优于基线的渲染质量。
conclusion: 提出统一的损失感知密度控制框架，用可解释的逐图元损失代理替代启发式规则，为3DGS在质量与预算效率之间取得更好平衡，并提升训练稳定性。

title: SHield: Watermarking 4D Gaussian Splatting via Spherical Harmonic Coefficient Perturbation
abstract: 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) models are computationally expensive to train but distributed as easily copied parameter files. Existing watermarks protect these assets by fine-tuning the scene against a neural decoder to extract bit strings from rendered video, a heavy process vulnerable to the temporal dynamics of dynamic scenes. However, if the threat model targets the redistributed file itself, verification can be vastly simplified.
