Because the canonical Spherical-Harmonic (SH) coefficients of 4DGS are time- and view-invariant, parameter-space perturbations can be recovered via deterministic arithmetic. We propose **SHield**, the first non-blind, decoder-free watermarking approach that natively embeds full-resolution RGB images into 4DGS files. SHield tiles a zero-mean payload across the SH coefficients of a key-selected Gaussian subset, applying a brief anchored optimization to preserve visual fidelity. To verify ownership, it geometrically re-associates the key using canonical Gaussian centres to survive file tampering and recovers the payload in closed form. Across 30 scenes (D-NeRF, HyperNeRF, DyNeRF), SHield guarantees near-perfect payload recovery (Pearson $r \geq 0.991$) on all 150 tested models with a mean rendering penalty of $\leq 0.13$~dB. Held-out evaluation yields perfect detection on 400 true trials and zero false positives across $1{,}600$ wrong-subset null trials. We also strictly bound the method's robustness: SHield survives INT8 quantization and $30\%$ opacity pruning for the image payload, and on aggressive SH-degree-1 truncation bit payloads are still decodable.
tldr: SHield通过扰动4DGS球谐系数嵌入全分辨率图像水印，无需解码器即可闭式验证版权。
motivation: 4DGS训练昂贵但参数文件易被复制，现有水印需针对神经解码器微调并从渲染视频提取比特串，流程重且受动态场景时序影响；若威胁模型针对分发文件本身，验证可大幅简化。
method: SHield利用4DGS规范球谐系数的时不变与视角不变特性，将零均值载荷平铺到密钥选中高斯子集的SH系数中，并用短暂锚定优化保持视觉保真；验证时基于规范高斯中心几何重关联密钥，以闭式算术恢复载荷。
result: 在D-NeRF、HyperNeRF、DyNeRF的30个场景150个模型上，图像载荷恢复Pearson r≥0.991，平均渲染损失≤0.13 dB；400次真实试验全检出、1600次错误子集零假阳性，并可在INT8量化、30%不透明度剪枝及SH一阶截断下解码相应载荷。
conclusion: SHield是首个面向4DGS文件本身的非盲、无解码器水印方法，实现高保真全分辨率图像嵌入与确定性所有权验证，为动态3D资产版权保护提供轻量方案，并明确刻画了其鲁棒性边界。

title: SceneBound: How Much Should a Streaming 3D Reconstruction Model Remember?
abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction models keep past video frames in a recurrent state, fast weights from test-time training, or a key-value (KV) cache. Each written frame shifts the coordinate frame of later cameras or occupies GPU memory. Training-free rules decide what to write from a signal of the current frame. How much they write accounts for their mean accuracy: spending the update budget of a gate at uniformly spaced frames, with no signal, matches nine published gates, and the budget bounds the drift of the state wherever the writes fall. We propose SceneBound, a training-free rule that writes a frame only when its predicted camera pose lies at least a fixed radius from every stored keyframe. Its keyframe count stays within a constant factor of the covering number of the visited poses, the fewest views that keep a keyframe near every camera, so the count grows with the places visited and stays flat when the camera returns. In large scenes, SceneBound closes a submap once decoding its first frame again reveals drift. SceneBound uses one radius across four released models and three memory types. In the recurrent state of CUT3R and the KV cache of StreamVGGT, it achieves the lowest mean trajectory error among the published training-free rules we evaluate, in one pass and over nine passes of a scene, where its keyframes grow by 3% to 6%.
tldr: SceneBound提出免训练关键帧写入规则，按相机位姿覆盖半径控制流式三维重建的记忆量。
motivation: 流式三维重建模型通过循环状态、测试时快速权重或KV缓存保留历史帧，但每写入一帧会偏移后续相机坐标系或占用GPU显存。现有免训练门控依据当前帧信号决定写入内容，而写入多少直接影响平均精度；摘要指出，均匀间隔花费更新预算即可匹配九种已发表门控，且预算约束状态漂移。
method: SceneBound是一种免训练规则：仅当预测相机位姿与所有已存关键帧的距离至少达到固定半径时才写入该帧。其关键帧数量保持在访问位姿覆盖数的常数倍内，随访问地点增加而增长、相机返回时保持平稳；在大场景中，当解码首帧再次暴露漂移时关闭子图，并对四个模型和三类记忆统一使用一个半径。
result: 在CUT3R的循环状态和StreamVGGT的KV缓存中，SceneBound在评估的已发表免训练规则中取得最低平均轨迹误差，覆盖单遍和九遍场景，关键帧仅增长3%至6%。
conclusion: SceneBound以位姿覆盖半径替代信号驱动门控，为流式三维重建提供可解释、免训练且跨模型/记忆类型通用的记忆写入策略，有助于在有限显存下控制漂移并保持轨迹精度。

title: LoD-Loc v4: Towards Generalized Aerial Visual Localization via Panoptic LoD 3D Map Registration
abstract: Aerial visual localization over Level-of-Detail (LoD) 3D Maps has recently gained significant traction due to its global scalability, storage efficiency, and privacy-preserving nature. However, existing methods rely almost exclusively on building elements, which leads to catastrophic localization failures in rural or undeveloped areas where buildings are sparse or non-existent. To address this, we construct a unified Panoptic LoD 3D Map by fusing OpenStreetMap (OSM), Digital Elevation Models (DEM), and LoD assets, reformulating the problem as a panoptic registration task. By parsing the query image into discrete building `thing' instances and continuous `stuff' regions comprising road, vegetation, and water, we establish a holistic alignment with this map to robustly optimize the camera pose. To enable reliable panoptic perception, we develop a new automated pipeline that constructs AirPan - the largest aerial panoptic segmentation dataset to date, comprising 85k images with pixel-accurate annotations. This empowers our panoptic segmentation model to exhibit remarkable zero-shot generalization capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LoD-Loc v4 consistently outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines by a significant margin. Most notably, it successfully maintains reliable localization in building-less scenarios, completely overcoming the catastrophic failures of prior building-centric paradigms.
tldr: 提出LoD-Loc v4，通过全景LoD 3D地图配准实现可泛化的空中视觉定位，并在无建筑场景保持可靠定位。
motivation: 现有LoD 3D地图空中视觉定位几乎完全依赖建筑元素，在建筑稀疏或不存在的乡村和欠发达地区会出现灾难性定位失败，亟需面向更广义场景的鲁棒定位方法。
method: 方法构建融合OSM、DEM与LoD资产的统一全景LoD 3D地图，将定位重构为全景配准任务；把查询图像解析为建筑“thing”实例及道路、植被、水体等连续“stuff”区域，与地图整体对齐并优化相机位姿。同时设计自动化流水线构建AirPan数据集（85k图像、像素级标注），提升全景分割模型的零样本泛化能力。
result: 大量实验表明LoD-Loc v4显著优于SOTA基线，并在无建筑场景下仍保持可靠定位，完全克服先前以建筑为中心范式的灾难性失败；摘要未给出具体定位误差等量化指标。
conclusion: LoD-Loc v4将全景LoD 3D地图配准引入空中视觉定位，显著提升场景泛化能力与无建筑环境鲁棒性，并贡献大规模AirPan数据集，为广义空中视觉定位提供新范式。

title: 3D Neural Rendering for Automated Ultrasonic Laser Scans
abstract: Laser doppler vibrometer (LDV) scans can be used to detect defects and cracks in manufactured parts before they are deployed. This work presents a method for reconstructing the steady-state surface wavefield of a three-dimensional part by combining automated robotic manipulation with neural rendering. A six-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) robotic manipulator (UFactory xArm6) with an embedded piezoelectric transducer presented an acoustically excited test article to a stationary LDV at a sequence of known orientations, yielding a set of complex-valued 2D scans with poses derived analytically from the arm kinematics rather than from image-based pose estimation. These scans were used to train a novel complex-nerfacto model, a modified Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) pipeline that replaces the standard three-channel RGB output head with a two-channel output. Complex-nerfacto represents the real and imaginary velocity components of a wavefield, preserving the complex measurement without quantization. Reconstructions of a welded aluminum cylinder and a welded T-bracket were evaluated against measured scans using Z-normalized cross-correlation (ZNCC). The complex-valued pipeline achieved a mean ZNCC of 0.60 at held-out viewing angles, compared with 0.28 for a baseline RGB nerfacto model trained on rendered images of the same data. The resulting surface wavefield reconstructions supported defect detection and characterization on complex components. We identify geometry reconstruction from sparse LDV scans as the remaining obstacle to practical deployment.
tldr: 结合六自由度机械臂与复数NeRF，从自动LDV扫描重建三维表面波场并用于缺陷检测。
motivation: LDV扫描可用于检测制件缺陷与裂纹，但复杂三维零件的稳态表面波场重建仍具挑战，且依赖图像位姿估计会限制自动化。本研究旨在利用机器人自动扫描与神经渲染实现三维复值波场重建。
method: 使用搭载压电换能器的UFactory xArm6六自由度机械臂，将声激励试件以已知位姿呈现给固定LDV，位姿由机械臂运动学解析获得而非图像估计。提出complex-nerfacto，将NeRF标准三通道RGB输出改为二通道，直接表示波场速度实部与虚部，保留复数测量且不量化。
result: 在焊接铝圆柱和焊接T型支架上，以ZNCC评估；复数管线在留出视角平均ZNCC为0.60，而同数据渲染图像训练的RGB nerfacto基线为0.28。重建波场支持复杂构件缺陷检测与表征。
conclusion: 结果表明复数神经渲染能有效重建LDV表面波场并提升缺陷检测能力；作者指出从稀疏LDV扫描重建几何仍是实际部署的主要障碍。

title: A Straight Line Is Not a Camera Pose: Auditing Short-Clip Pose Benchmarks
abstract: The absolute trajectory error (ATE) is the standard measure of camera-motion accuracy, from SLAM to feed-forward 3D reconstruction. On the common Sintel protocol, a constant-velocity straight line using no images has a lower mean ATE than 10 of 11 recent models re-run with official code. Two properties of ATE's alignment explain this. First, it maps any constant-velocity prediction onto the best-fitting line through the true path, so the line scores the path's regression residual. A residual signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) criterion predicts when moving a prediction towards its constant-velocity fit lowers ATE. It gives the outcome for 95% of 1056 model-clip pairs, 98% of 792 held-out pairs and 97% of 1034 ScanNet pairs, and it separates Sintel (median SNR 0.86) from TUM, ScanNet and full-length Bonn and Wild-SLAM (2.7 to 27), where straightening raises every model's mean ATE. Second, position-only alignment ignores where cameras look: rotating a trajectory by 30 degrees against its orientations leaves ATE unchanged, yet worsens the reprojection of static points for every model on Sintel, TUM and ScanNet in the main setting, and the line, second by mean ATE on Sintel, places them worst by geometric mean: a lower ATE need not mean better geometry. Fitting the alignment's rotation to the predicted orientations gives pose-anchored ATE, a one-function change in ATE's units costing 0.17 ms per clip (ATE: 0.11 ms). It ranks every image-free reference below every model on Sintel, tracks the reprojection error under rotation and straightening, where ATE does not (Spearman 0.61 vs. 0.32), largely preserves the models' order, and ties 10-frame translational relative pose error (RPE) and the discernible trajectory error (DTE) on our rotation and reference tests. Code, predictions and results will be released.
tldr: 本文审计短片段相机位姿基准，揭示ATE可被无图像匀速直线预测欺骗，并提出位姿锚定ATE。
motivation: 绝对轨迹误差（ATE）是SLAM与三维重建中相机运动精度的标准指标，但短片段基准可能因对齐方式产生误导。作者要检验ATE是否真正反映相机位姿与几何质量，并找出其失效条件。
method: 通过理论分析ATE对齐的两个性质：位置对齐会将匀速预测映射到真实路径的最佳拟合直线，并用残差信噪比（SNR）预测直线化何时降低ATE；同时指出仅位置对齐忽略相机朝向。提出pose-anchored ATE，将对齐旋转拟合到预测朝向，仅改变单位且每片段耗时0.17 ms。
result: 在Sintel协议上，无图像匀速直线平均ATE低于11个近期模型中的10个；SNR准则预测1056个模型-片段对中95%、792个留出对中98%、1034个ScanNet对中97%的结果，并区分Sintel（中位SNR 0.86）与TUM/ScanNet/Bonn/Wild-SLAM（2.7-27）。旋转轨迹30度不改变ATE但恶化重投影，pose-anchored ATE在Sintel将全部无图像参考排在所有模型之后，并在旋转/直线化下跟踪重投影误差（Spearman 0.61 vs. 0.32）。
conclusion: 研究表明低ATE不一定代表更好的几何，短片段位姿基准存在被平凡预测刷分的风险。pose-anchored ATE以极小开销提供更符合朝向与几何误差的排序，作者将开源代码、预测与结果。

title: Rethinking Asymmetry in Self-Supervised 3D Geometry Learning
abstract: Self-supervised learning relies on asymmetry between what a model observes and what it must explain. Recent methods learn 3D geometry from unposed images by predicting cameras and scene structure, then rendering held-out views. To avoid trivial solutions, they impose this asymmetry in the input space, restricting how views interact through separate branches or masked attention. We revisit this design with geometric accuracy, rather than rendering quality, as the main objective. When a held-out view lies between context views, the context already constrains the geometry it observes. We therefore impose the asymmetry in the 3D representation space, excluding held-out views only from the reconstructed scene while a shared backbone uses all views for correspondence. This improves depth and pose estimation over input-space designs. We further exploit view density: sparse and dense observations depict the same scene but provide different amounts of correspondence. Aligning sparse-context features with dense-context features supplies a geometric training signal alongside rendering, without a pretrained geometric teacher. We additionally align features with a frozen vision foundation model, which brings further gains. None of these signals requires geometric annotation, and the resulting model improves geometry estimation over prior self-supervised methods. Controlled experiments isolate the contribution of each component, and self-supervised pretraining also improves subsequent supervised training.
tldr: 提出在3D表示空间施加非对称性的自监督几何学习方法，利用稠密-稀疏特征对齐提升深度与位姿估计。
motivation: 现有自监督3D几何方法常将非对称性施加在输入空间，通过分离分支或掩码注意力限制视图交互以避免渲染退化解，但该设计并非以几何精度为核心目标。当留出视图位于上下文视图之间时，上下文已约束其几何，输入空间限制并非必要。
method: 将非对称性改到3D表示空间：共享主干利用所有视图建立对应关系，仅在重建场景时排除留出视图；并利用视图密度差异，将稀疏上下文特征与稠密上下文特征对齐作为额外几何训练信号，同时对齐冻结视觉基础模型特征，且均无需几何标注。
result: 摘要未给出具体数值指标；实验表明该设计在深度和位姿估计上优于输入空间非对称性方案及先前自监督方法，受控实验验证了各组件贡献，自监督预训练还能提升后续有监督训练。
conclusion: 该方法重新审视自监督3D几何学习中的非对称性位置，证明3D表示空间约束与稠密-稀疏特征对齐可在无几何标注下提供有效监督，并为自监督预训练迁移到有监督3D任务提供支持。

title: PGGT-Loc: Primitive-Grounded Geometry Transformer for Feed-Forward Camera Localization
abstract: Camera localization methods are mostly multi-stage pipelines relying on dedicated and complex maps that are costly to construct, store, and maintain over time. Alternatively, well-structured maps that organize scenes with compact yet expressive primitives are often readily available, providing rich structural and semantic cues that humans can interpret. However, their potential for direct camera localization remains largely unexplored due to the significant modality gap between map primitives and visual observations. This motivates a new concept for localization, which estimates camera poses by grounding query observations to map primitives. In this paper, we instantiate the concept in the context of planar primitives with PGGT, the Primitive-Grounded Geometry Transformer network. Given a single query image and a set of planar map primitives, the network is trained to predict multiple localization targets for feed-forward 6-DoF camera localization that generalizes to unseen environments. With this straightforward and scalable architecture, our method pushes the state-of-the-art localization performance on both dense surface maps and minimal layout models. The code and models are available at https://github.com/3dv-casia/PGGT-Loc
tldr: 提出PGGT，将单张图像与平面地图基元对齐，实现前馈6-DoF相机定位并提升跨场景泛化。
motivation: 现有相机定位多依赖多阶段流程和复杂专用地图，构建、存储与维护成本高。结构化地图中的紧凑基元富含结构与语义线索，但与视觉观测存在显著模态差异，其直接用于定位的潜力尚未被充分探索。
method: 提出Primitive-Grounded Geometry Transformer（PGGT），以单张查询图像和一组平面地图基元为输入，通过将观测 grounding 到地图基元来预测多个定位目标，实现前馈式6-DoF相机定位，并可泛化到未见环境。
result: 该方法在稠密表面地图和极简布局模型上均推动定位性能达到新的state-of-the-art；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 工作验证了基于平面基元直接进行相机定位的新概念，并提供结构简单、可扩展的架构；代码与模型已开源，有望促进基元地图在定位任务中的应用。

title: A Self-Supervised Pose Estimation Approach for Construction Machines
abstract: Pose estimation is a computer vision task used to estimate a skeleton of dynamic systems to predict future movements. Most of the research in this direction is based on a supervised learning approach which requires a massive amount of labeled datasets. In this paper, a self-supervised three-stage model based on a contrastive learning approach is introduced for estimating a skeleton of dynamic construction machines; such as excavators without using any labeled images for the first stage. The whole model structure is divided into three stages: the pre-train stage using the SimCLR contrastive approach, and two fine-tuning stages for the transfer learning and the downstream task. The model can leverage the features and learn from a huge unlabeled dataset called ACID to two small datasets generated from NVIDIA Isaac and MATLAB Simscape simulators as well as transfer the knowledge to a smaller dataset with a ratio of 3.5% from the original ACID dataset. The results show that the proposed approach can improve the accuracy of pose estimation for heavy construction machines in real images by 11% and 13% in comparison to the normal self-supervised approach with two backbones ResNet-50 and HRNet-W32, respectively.
tldr: 提出基于SimCLR对比学习的自监督三阶段姿态估计方法，在无标注预训练下将工程机械真实图像姿态估计精度分别提升11%和13%。
motivation: 现有工程机械姿态估计多依赖监督学习，需要大量标注数据，成本高且难以扩展。本文旨在第一阶段不使用任何标注图像的情况下，估计挖掘机等动态施工机械的骨架。
method: 模型分为三阶段：先用SimCLR对比学习在大型无标注ACID数据集上预训练，再通过迁移学习在NVIDIA Isaac和MATLAB Simscape生成的小数据集上微调，最后面向下游任务微调；并验证向仅占ACID原始数据3.5%的小数据集迁移的能力。
result: 在真实图像上的重型施工机械姿态估计中，相比常规自监督方法，ResNet-50和HRNet-W32骨干网络分别取得11%和13%的精度提升。
conclusion: 结果表明，对比学习预训练结合多阶段迁移可有效减少对标注数据的依赖，并提升工程机械真实场景姿态估计性能，为施工机械自动化感知提供了可行路线。

title: OpenVIO: A Versatile Open-Source Visual-Inertial Odometry System
abstract: Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) is a fundamental topic in robotics research. Beyond research, VIO has been adopted in a wide range of products. In this manuscript, we present OpenVIO, an open-source VIO system for research and practical applications. It is released under the MIT license. OpenVIO supports pinhole and fisheye cameras and extends this support to stitched 360° images. We describe each part of the system together with its design considerations. We also report benchmark results with other open-source VIO systems on public datasets. OpenVIO is available as open source at https://github.com/93won/openvio.
tldr: OpenVIO是一个支持针孔、鱼眼和拼接360°图像的MIT开源VIO系统。
motivation: 视觉惯性里程计是机器人研究的基础问题，并已广泛用于实际产品；作者希望提供一个兼顾研究与实际应用的开源VIO系统。
method: OpenVIO以MIT许可证开源，支持针孔相机、鱼眼相机，并扩展到拼接360°图像；论文介绍了系统各组成部分及其设计考虑，并在公开数据集上与其他开源VIO系统进行基准测试。
result: 摘要仅说明在公开数据集上与其他开源VIO系统进行了基准对比，未给出具体量化指标。
conclusion: OpenVIO作为MIT许可的开源VIO系统，覆盖多种相机模型并包含基准评估，有望服务于机器人研究与实际应用。

title: DrawSplat: Atlanta World-Guided Implicit Gaussian SLAM for Indoor Reconstruction
abstract: RGB-D SLAM requires accurate online tracking, high-quality rendering, and geometrically consistent reconstruction. Existing Gaussian SLAM methods mainly optimize Gaussian primitives with photometric, depth, or local frame-to-model constraints, which are often insufficient in indoor scenes with weak textures, large planar structures, noisy depth, and long trajectories. The resulting maps may suffer from pose drift, surface thickness artifacts, noisy normals, and blurred structural boundaries. We propose DrawSplat, an Atlanta World-guided implicit Gaussian SLAM framework for indoor reconstruction. DrawSplat follows a drawing-like process: explicit point-line geometry first sketches the structural layout, and implicit neural Gaussians then fill in high-fidelity appearance and continuous geometric details. It estimates camera poses, sparse geometry, and gravity direction through point-line joint tracking, infers structural planes from tracked lines using the shared-gravity component of the Atlanta World prior, and converts them into differentiable regularization terms on Gaussian centers and normals. To improve compactness and efficiency, DrawSplat further combines an anchor-based implicit neural Gaussian representation with adaptive structural sampling, which allocates Gaussian capacity to structurally informative regions. Experiments on multiple datasets show that DrawSplat achieves robust tracking, high-fidelity rendering, and strong geometric reconstruction among Gaussian-based SLAM systems, while maintaining a practical balance among quality, efficiency, and model size.
tldr: DrawSplat利用Atlanta World先验引导隐式高斯SLAM，实现室内鲁棒跟踪与高质量重建。
motivation: 现有Gaussian SLAM主要依赖光度、深度或局部帧到模型约束优化高斯基元，在弱纹理、大平面、深度噪声和长轨迹的室内场景中容易产生位姿漂移、表面厚度伪影、法向噪声与结构边界模糊。该文旨在提升室内RGB-D SLAM的在线跟踪、渲染质量和几何一致性。
method: DrawSplat采用类似绘图的过程：先由显式点线几何勾勒结构布局，再用隐式神经高斯填充高保真外观与连续几何细节。方法通过点线联合跟踪估计相机位姿、稀疏几何和重力方向，利用Atlanta World先验的共享重力分量从跟踪线推断结构平面，并将其转化为对高斯中心和法向的可微正则项；同时结合基于锚点的隐式神经高斯表示与自适应结构采样，将高斯容量分配给结构信息丰富区域。
result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，DrawSplat在基于高斯的SLAM系统中实现了鲁棒跟踪、高保真渲染和较强几何重建，并在质量、效率与模型大小之间取得实用平衡；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: DrawSplat将显式点线结构先验与隐式神经高斯表示统一到Atlanta World引导的SLAM框架中，为弱纹理、大平面室内场景提供了兼顾跟踪、渲染和几何一致性的重建方案，并展示了质量、效率与模型紧凑性之间的良好折中。

title: Queryable Gaussian View Index: Text Retrieval and Selective Camera Localization
abstract: We present Queryable Gaussian View Index (QGVI) for querying existing Gaussian scene assets and their associated calibrated reference data. Text-view retrieval and selective RGB camera localization return poses in the asset's coordinate frame. QGVI-T turns Gaussian-rendered views into a language-searchable index of scene locations, binding structured captions to known camera poses and place identifiers. Semantic and lexical retrieval select views from distinct places without online rendering, VLM calls, or a scene-specific pose network. The image route, QGVI-I, filters LoGS-based geometric estimates using distinct inlier query keypoints. It omits photometric refinement and preserves accepted pose coordinates. On nine development scenes, QGVI-T achieves 58.3% Top-1 and 78.3% Top-5 joint relevance-and-validity success, compared with 26.1% and 34.6% for our CityLoC reimplementation with refinement. QGVI-I achieves 97.3% scene-mean pose success at 1 m/2 degrees, with pooled false-acceptance and false-rejection rates of 0.707% and 1.142%. A paired cached evaluation retains all 1,775 initializer poses correct at this threshold. Recorded median text query latency is 0.020 s. Matched controls show competitive BM25 retrieval and slightly lower false acceptance for thresholded full LoGS; grid augmentation suggests modest gains on novel-view-derived descriptions. We report model-judged semantic success separately from source-camera recovery, with source-verified or estimated scales for geometric evaluation.
tldr: 提出QGVI，用文本检索高斯渲染视图并选择性定位RGB相机，返回资产坐标系位姿。
motivation: 旨在复用已有高斯场景资产及其标定参考数据，支持文本检索场景视图与选择性RGB相机定位，避免在线渲染、VLM调用和场景专用位姿网络。
method: QGVI-T将高斯渲染视图与结构化描述、已知相机位姿和地点标识绑定，构建可语义/词法检索的视图索引；QGVI-I基于LoGS几何估计并用查询关键点内点过滤，省略光度细化并保留被接受位姿坐标。
result: 在九个开发场景上，QGVI-T的Top-1/Top-5联合相关性与有效性成功率为58.3%/78.3%，高于CityLoC重实现的26.1%/34.6%；QGVI-I在1 m/2°下场景平均位姿成功率达97.3%，误接受/误拒绝率为0.707%/1.142%，缓存评估中1,775个初始化位姿全部正确，文本查询中位延迟0.020 s。
conclusion: QGVI为高斯场景资产提供无需在线渲染和场景专用网络的文本检索与选择性定位接口；其检索精度、定位成功率和低延迟表明可用于高效场景查询与相机重定位，并强调语义成功与源相机恢复分开评估。

title: LucidLyra: Feed-Forward Generative 3D Scene Reconstruction and Joint Understanding via Multi-Task Distillation
abstract: We present LucidLyra, a framework that makes generatively reconstructed 3D scenes directly queryable for semantics and instances in a feed-forward manner from video latents. While generative 3D reconstruction can synthesize virtual environments from a single image, downstream applications in robotics and physical AI require not only visual realism but also access to scene semantics and object identities. Existing 3D understanding approaches, however, require captured multi-view scenes, have limited generalization capabilities, or rely on expensive per-scene processing and optimization. To bridge this gap, our method distills complementary knowledge from a camera-controlled video diffusion model and frozen 2D vision foundation models into a unified model to jointly infer 3D Gaussians encoding geometry, appearance, open-vocabulary semantics, and class-agnostic instance cues. The resulting scenes support novel-view rendering, open-vocabulary segmentation, and object grouping without per-scene optimization, while training requires neither manual 3D annotations nor captured multi-view data. Our method outperforms baselines combining state-of-the-art 3DGS segmentation approaches with generative 3D scene reconstruction on curated synthetic and real-image-conditioned benchmarks, while preserving reconstruction quality. Furthermore, our latent formulation naturally extends to monocular video, reconstructing structured dynamic 3D scenes across time. By turning renderable but unstructured outputs into queryable 3D worlds, LucidLyra enables downstream applications including 3D scene editing, 3D asset mining, and robotic simulation.
tldr: LucidLyra通过多任务蒸馏将视频扩散与2D基础模型知识注入前馈3D高斯，实现可查询语义与实例的生成式3D场景重建。
motivation: 生成式3D重建虽能从单图合成虚拟环境，但机器人与物理AI应用还需要场景语义和对象身份信息。现有3D理解方法依赖捕获的多视角场景、泛化能力有限，或需要昂贵的逐场景处理与优化，缺少无需3D标注和多视角数据的前馈联合重建与理解方案。
method: 该方法从相机可控视频扩散模型和冻结的2D视觉基础模型中蒸馏互补知识到统一模型，前馈推断编码几何、外观、开放词汇语义和类无关实例线索的3D Gaussians。所得场景无需逐场景优化即可支持新视角渲染、开放词汇分割和对象分组，训练既不需要人工3D标注也不需要捕获的多视角数据，并可自然扩展到单目视频的动态3D场景重建。
result: 在精心构建的合成与真实图像条件基准上，LucidLyra优于将最先进3DGS分割方法与生成式3D场景重建相结合的基线，同时保持重建质量；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: LucidLyra将可渲染但非结构化的生成式3D输出转化为可查询的3D世界，支持3D场景编辑、3D资产挖掘和机器人仿真等下游应用，并为前馈生成式重建与联合理解提供统一框架。

title: InfantNet: A Large Scale Dataset for Infant Body Pose and Shape Estimation
abstract: Infant pose and shape estimation is essential for applications in childcare, developmental monitoring, and medical diagnosis. However, existing methods and datasets are largely designed for adults, and direct transfer to infants fails due to substantial differences in body proportions, articulation limits, and frequent self-occlusion. To address this gap, we introduce InfantNet, the largest real-image infant dataset to date, comprising 108,902 RGB images of infants aged 6-18 months. Each image is annotated with 2D keypoints, and a curated subset of 11,642 images additionally includes 3D pose and shape annotations with full SMIL parameters, verified through multi-view rendering and reprojection-error filtering. We use an iterative annotation pipeline to ensure high fidelity across both 2D and 3D labels. InfantNet establishes a large-scale, comprehensive benchmark for infant 2D keypoint detection and 3D pose-and-shape recovery. Baseline experiments demonstrate that state-of-the-art adult pose estimators do not generalize well to infants, whereas fine-tuning on InfantNet yields a consistent improvement. The gains are even more pronounced for 3D pose and shape estimation, where SMIL-based estimation demonstrates robust performance with accuracy comparable to results reported for SMPL-based models. By releasing the InfantNet dataset and benchmark, we provide a vital resource for advancing infant pose analysis and related healthcare applications.
tldr: 提出迄今最大婴儿真实图像数据集InfantNet，含2D关键点与部分3D姿态形状标注，并建立基准。
motivation: 现有姿态与形状估计方法和数据集主要面向成人，因婴儿身体比例、关节活动范围和频繁自遮挡差异，直接迁移效果差；本文旨在填补婴儿真实图像大规模标注与基准的空白。
method: 构建InfantNet：包含108,902张6–18月龄婴儿RGB图像，全部标注2D关键点，其中11,642张额外提供带完整SMIL参数的3D姿态与形状标注；采用迭代标注流程，并通过多视角渲染与重投影误差过滤校验3D标签。基于该数据建立2D关键点检测和3D姿态形状恢复基准。
result: 基线实验表明，现有成人SOTA姿态估计器迁移到婴儿时泛化较差，而在InfantNet上微调可带来一致提升；3D姿态与形状估计的增益更明显，基于SMIL的估计性能稳健，精度与SMPL类模型报告结果相当。
conclusion: 发布InfantNet数据集与基准，为婴儿姿态分析及相关医疗健康应用提供关键资源，并推动婴儿专用模型发展。

title: PhysInsert: Physically Plausible Object Insertion with Geometric Priors and Bidirectional Object-Scene Interactions
abstract: We present PhysInsert, a framework for physically plausible reference-based object insertion that jointly adapts objects and their surrounding scenes. Existing methods often rely on masked inputs, generation-based pairs, or training pairs with limited viewpoint variation, leaving pose and illumination adaptation and bidirectional object-scene interactions insufficiently constrained. We construct the Insert World dataset with strictly aligned Blender-rendered counterfactual pairs and object references across viewpoints and lighting conditions. Building on these data, Geometry-Guided Adaptation couples a VGGT geometry stream with image and text streams under target-scene feature supervision to guide spatially consistent insertion. Complementary 2D Object-Scene Spatial Supervision jointly supervises object occupancy and environmental changes while grounding spatial instructions in object regions through image-text attention. We introduce PhysInsert-Bench with dedicated cross-environment and cross-view cases requiring illumination and pose adaptation beyond appearance copying. Experiments on PhysInsert-Bench and DreamBooth demonstrate improved image fidelity; a user study further shows more accurate placement and improved lighting integration, perspective, and pose plausibility.
tldr: PhysInsert结合几何先验与双向物体-场景交互，实现物理合理的参考物体插入。
motivation: 现有参考物体插入方法常依赖掩码输入、生成式配对或视角变化有限的训练对，导致姿态与光照适配以及物体-场景双向交互约束不足。研究旨在联合适配物体与周围场景，实现物理合理且空间一致的插入。
method: 构建Insert World数据集，包含跨视角与光照条件下严格对齐的Blender渲染反事实配对及物体参考。提出Geometry-Guided Adaptation，在目标场景特征监督下耦合VGGT几何流与图像、文本流；并设计2D Object-Scene Spatial Supervision，联合监督物体占据与环境变化，通过图文注意力将空间指令定位到物体区域。进一步提出PhysInsert-Bench，包含需光照与姿态适配的跨环境、跨视角案例。
result: 在PhysInsert-Bench和DreamBooth上的实验表明图像保真度提升；用户研究显示物体放置更准确，光照融合、透视和姿态合理性更好，但摘要未给出具体量化指标。
conclusion: PhysInsert通过几何先验与双向物体-场景交互提升了参考物体插入的物理合理性与空间一致性，并贡献了Insert World数据集和PhysInsert-Bench基准。该工作有望推动可控图像编辑与场景合成中物体插入的评估与建模。

title: MLLM-GS: Multimodal Large Language Model Prior-Guided Fast Novel View Synthesis in Extreme Environments
abstract: Novel view synthesis (NVS) in degraded scenes aims to reconstruct 3D scenes from multi-view observations affected by various degradations, and to generate clear and photorealistic images at unseen viewpoints. Despite recent advances, existing methods often rely on degradation-specific models, limiting their generalization across diverse extreme environments. Generative models provide rich visual priors, but their outputs often suffer from pixel misalignment and color deviations, which can propagate into the reconstructed 3D scene and compromise reconstruction quality. Furthermore, the high computational and memory costs of 3D reconstruction hinder the practical application of NVS in extreme environments. To this end, we propose MLLM-GS, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) prior-guided framework for fast NVS in extreme environments. MLLM-GS consists of two branches: MLLM prior-guided view enhancement and fast 3D scene reconstruction. The former leverages the rich visual priors of a frozen MLLM to enhance views under different severe degradations and introduces a lightweight correction network to reduce pixel shifts and color distortions in MLLM outputs. With supervision from only a few paired clean views, this branch produces reliable enhanced views for all degraded observations, providing pseudo-GT views for subsequent 3D reconstruction. The latter improves 3DGS efficiency by optimizing rasterization, Gaussian memory layout, and parameter updates, reducing redundant computation, memory-access overhead, and optimization costs. Extensive experiments on multiple degraded scenes demonstrate that MLLM-GS effectively handles various severe degradations and achieves high-quality NVS with significantly lower reconstruction time and memory consumption. Project Page: https://wzlwlm13.github.io/MLLM-GS
tldr: MLLM-GS利用冻结MLLM视觉先验与轻量校正网络增强退化视图，并加速3DGS重建。
motivation: 现有极端退化场景下的新视角合成方法多依赖特定退化模型，跨环境泛化能力不足；生成模型虽有丰富视觉先验，但输出存在像素错位和颜色偏差，易传播到3D重建中；同时3D重建计算与内存开销高，阻碍实际应用。
method: 提出MLLM-GS双分支框架：一支使用冻结的多模态大语言模型视觉先验增强不同严重退化视图，并引入轻量校正网络减少像素偏移和颜色失真，仅需少量配对清晰视图监督即可为所有退化观测生成可靠伪真值视图；另一支通过优化光栅化、高斯内存布局和参数更新提升3DGS效率，降低冗余计算、内存访问和优化成本。
result: 在多个退化场景上的广泛实验表明，MLLM-GS能有效处理多种严重退化，实现高质量新视角合成，并显著降低重建时间和内存消耗；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: MLLM-GS将MLLM先验引导的视图增强与高效3DGS重建结合，提升了极端环境下新视角合成的泛化性与实用性，为快速高质量NVS提供了可推广框架。

title: ACD-GS: Asymmetric Curvature-aware Densification for 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for real-time photorealistic novel view synthesis. However, its training-time densification remains largely heuristic, often resulting in redundant Gaussian proliferation and inaccurate geometric reconstruction. Existing methods predominantly rely on first-order screen-space gradients to trigger cloning and splitting, which fail to distinguish true geometric discontinuities from high-frequency textures or noisy residuals. To address this limitation, we propose ACD-GS, an Asymmetric Curvature-aware Densification framework for compact and geometry-aware 3D Gaussian optimization. Our key insight is that second-order depth responses provide a more reliable structural prior for density control, enabling asymmetric regulation of cloning and splitting to better capture geometric discontinuities. Building on this, we introduce a multi-view photometric consistency constraint to suppress transient single-view errors, together with a capacity-aware adaptive regulation strategy that balances densification and pruning during training. Unlike post-hoc compression or quantization-based approaches, ACD-GS directly prevents redundant Gaussian generation during training, yielding inherently compact representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method reduces nearly 60% of Gaussian count and storage while maintaining competitive rendering fidelity, consistently outperforming existing methods across multiple datasets. Our code is available in https://waveviewer.github.io/ACD-GS/.
tldr: ACD-GS利用二阶深度曲率非对称调控3DGS致密化，在保持渲染质量的同时减少近60%高斯数量与存储。
motivation: 3DGS训练期致密化高度启发式，常导致高斯冗余和几何重建不准；现有方法仅依赖一阶屏幕空间梯度触发克隆/分裂，难以区分真实几何不连续与高频纹理或噪声残差。
method: 提出ACD-GS，以二阶深度响应作为结构先验，非对称调控克隆与分裂以捕捉几何不连续；引入多视角光度一致性约束抑制单视角瞬态误差，并用容量感知自适应调节在训练中平衡致密化与剪枝。
result: 实验表明该方法在高斯数量与存储上减少近60%，同时保持有竞争力的渲染保真度，并在多个数据集上持续优于现有方法。
conclusion: ACD-GS在训练中直接抑制冗余高斯生成，获得紧凑且几何感知的3DGS表示，避免后处理压缩或量化；为实时新视角合成提供更高效方案。

title: UMI-Live for In-The-Wild Bimanual Robotics Data Collection
abstract: Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) devices allow human experts to demonstrate tasks for robot learning without teleoperating physical robots. Using these demonstrations as training data still requires a consistent hardware setup, calibration, and data processing. We present UMI-Live, a full-stack open-source bimanual UMI system for in-the-wild data collection. We design our custom UMI-Live hardware to integrate camera and LiDAR--inertial sensing, onboard compute, and power, without external tracking equipment or calibration within the collection environment. We implement a simple user interface for recording data while an asynchronous pipeline performs parallel SLAM reconstruction and publishes training-ready datasets. We also release software that supports dual-YAM teleoperation and VLA policy training and inference. We validate UMI-Live data quality by fine-tuning $π_{0.5}$ and MolmoAct2, achieving success rates of 10/10 and 8/10, respectively on a bimanual pick-and-place task. Furthermore, we release 40 hours of UMI-Live data across three tasks, and complete hardware designs, software, and reproduction guides at our $\href{https://umi-live.github.io/}{\text{project website}}$.
tldr: 提出全栈开源双臂UMI-Live系统，实现野外无外部跟踪设备的数据采集与训练就绪数据集生成。
motivation: UMI设备让专家无需遥操作实体机器人即可演示任务，但将演示用作训练数据仍依赖一致的硬件配置、标定与数据处理。本文旨在构建可在真实野外环境中便捷采集双臂数据的全栈系统。
method: 设计集成相机、LiDAR-惯性传感、板载计算与供电的定制UMI-Live硬件，采集环境内无需外部跟踪设备或标定；提供简单录制界面，并由异步流水线并行执行SLAM重建、发布可直接训练的数据集。软件还支持双YAM遥操作及VLA策略训练与推理。
result: 通过微调π_{0.5}与MolmoAct2验证数据质量，在双臂拾放任务上分别取得10/10和8/10成功率；并开源覆盖三类任务、共40小时的UMI-Live数据及硬件设计、软件与复现指南。
conclusion: UMI-Live降低了野外双臂数据采集的硬件与标定门槛，打通从采集、重建到VLA训练/推理的流程，并以开源全栈资源促进机器人学习数据规模化。

title: COGS: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Attribute-Aware Object-Level 3D Gaussian Splatting Perception
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is increasingly explored as an input representation for 3D perception. Yet it remains unclear how current 3D architectures exploit heterogeneous Gaussian attributes. This ambiguity makes accuracy hard to interpret and limits principled architecture design for 3DGS perception. However, existing object-level 3DGS datasets lack the appearance variation or artifact control needed for systematic attribute-level analysis. We introduce COGS, a large-scale 3DGS dataset with 15,675 artifact-filtered and appearance-rich objects across 40 categories. Built on COGS, we establish COGS-Bench for object classification and attribute-usage diagnosis, complemented by external validation. Our benchmark shows that Gaussian attributes are not uniformly beneficial: selected subsets can outperform the full attribute set, and the effects of appearance, opacity, and covariance-related attribute combinations vary substantially across architectures. We further study this finding with HALO, a reference model that preserves attribute-specific evidence before hierarchical aggregation. Experiments on COGS-Bench and external 3DGS datasets demonstrate that COGS supports systematic diagnosis of 3DGS attribute usage, while HALO highlights the value of role-preserving attribute organization. Our dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/XiaoZhengCV/COGS.
tldr: 提出COGS大规模3DGS属性诊断基准与HALO模型，揭示不同高斯属性组合对3D感知架构的非均匀影响。
motivation: 现有3DGS感知架构如何利用异构高斯属性尚不清晰，且已有对象级3DGS数据集缺乏外观变化与伪影控制，难以进行系统的属性级分析。
method: 构建COGS数据集，包含40类15,675个经伪影过滤且外观丰富的对象，并建立COGS-Bench用于对象分类与属性使用诊断；同时提出HALO参考模型，在层次聚合前保留属性特定证据。
result: 基准实验表明高斯属性并非一致有益：部分属性子集可优于完整属性集，且外观、不透明度与协方差相关属性组合的影响随架构显著变化；外部3DGS数据集验证了COGS的诊断能力与HALO的有效性。
conclusion: COGS支持对3DGS属性使用进行系统诊断，HALO凸显角色保持型属性组织的价值，为面向3DGS感知的架构设计提供原则性依据。

title: Joint Rigid Alignment and Morphable Reconstruction from Partial 3D Face Scans
abstract: Aligning a partial, real-world 3D face scan to a canonical representation requires solving two coupled problems at once: estimating the rigid pose that brings the scan into a common frame, and completing the facial shape in regions the scan never observed. Existing pipelines typically decouple these steps, running a generic point-cloud registration front end followed by a separate non-rigid fitting or deformation stage. Building on the GeoTransformer superpoint-matching architecture, we propose a single network that predicts both a rigid pose and a shape-complete point cloud in one forward pass: a cross-attention regressor, conditioned on transformer point features and predicted coarse correspondences, maps a partial scan to per-patch coefficients of a 3D morphable face model learned offline from a corpus of 8,000 identities. The resulting morphed template is then used, in the same forward pass, as the target for fine-grained Sinkhorn matching and rigid pose estimation, supervised purely by geometric alignment to ground-truth morphed geometry, so no hand-labeled coefficients are required. Against six classical and learned non-rigid registration baselines on held-out identities, our method leads the strongest ones by 3-4 times on per-vertex error and baselines that collapse the head onto the visible region by more than an order of magnitude, and is simultaneously the most accurate and fastest method on ground-truth-free scans from two independent real-scan datasets, NoW and NPHM. Code will be made publicly available.
tldr: 提出单次前向联合预测刚性位姿与完整人脸点云的3D人脸配准与形变重建网络。
motivation: 部分3D人脸扫描与规范模型对齐需同时估计刚性位姿并补全未观测区域，但现有流程通常先通用点云配准再单独非刚性拟合，步骤解耦且易误差累积。
method: 基于GeoTransformer超点匹配构建单一网络，用交叉注意力回归器结合Transformer点特征与粗对应预测每patch的3DMM系数，3DMM从8000个身份离线学习；同一前向中生成形变模板作为Sinkhorn细匹配与刚性位姿估计目标，仅用几何对齐监督，无需人工系数标签。
result: 在留出身份上对比六种经典与学习型非刚性配准基线，每顶点误差比最强基线低3-4倍，较将头部塌缩到可见区域的基线优一个数量级以上；在NoW和NPHM两个真实扫描数据集的无真值扫描上同时取得最高精度和最快速度。
conclusion: 该方法将刚性对齐与可形变人脸补全统一到单次前向，避免手工系数监督，提升部分3D人脸扫描配准的精度与效率，代码将公开。

title: Tactus: Tactile & Pose Sensing Glove for Natural Dexterity Data Collection
abstract: Collecting naturalistic human manipulation demonstrations with accurate contact force and hand pose is essential for robot dexterous manipulation policy and foundational world model learning - yet no existing wearable platform provides both calibrated fingertip force sensing and occlusion-resilient hand tracking in a form factor that preserves natural manipulation behavior. We present Tactus, a textile-integrated sensing glove that co-optimizes three design pillars: (1) a thin, conformal 3D-knit form factor (1.5 mm fingertip stackup) designed to minimize interference with natural manipulation, (2) strategically placed capacitive tactile sensors at manipulation-relevant regions informed by empirical contact studies, and (3) IMU-fused pose tracking that maintains accuracy through the hand-object occlusions where manipulation data is most valuable. Tactus includes a documented calibration pipeline for cross-glove consistency and per-session calibration for subject-dependent correction. To enable objective comparison, we introduce standardized benchmarking protocols for tactile force regression and hand pose estimation, and apply them to Tactus and two commercially available tactile gloves - to our knowledge the first quantitative cross-platform evaluation of this kind. Tactus resolves a minimum detectable force of 0.59 N at 95% confidence, 1.6 - 2.7x lower than the commercial baselines, and with 0.87 cross-participant consistency, while our pose tracking sustains 11.0 mm fingertip keypoint relative error during manipulation, when occlusion is heaviest. We show that these combined signals support object property estimation, slip detection, and representative recording of hand-object interaction - yielding demonstration data with the fidelity required for contact-aware manipulation policies and world models.
tldr: Tactus 是可同时采集指尖触觉与抗遮挡手部位姿的纺织手套，用于高保真灵巧操作数据收集。
motivation: 机器人灵巧操作策略与世界模型学习需要带精确接触力和手部位姿的自然人类操作演示，但现有可穿戴平台无法同时提供校准的指尖力传感与抗遮挡手部跟踪，且难以保持自然操作行为。
method: 提出 Tactus 纺织集成传感手套，围绕三大设计支柱协同优化：1.5 mm 指尖堆叠的薄型共形 3D-knit 结构以减少对自然操作的干扰；依据实证接触研究在操作相关区域布置电容式触觉传感器；采用 IMU 融合的位姿跟踪以在手物遮挡下保持精度。还建立跨手套一致性校准流程与会话级校准，并提出触觉力回归和手部位姿估计的标准化基准协议，对 Tactus 与两款商用触觉手套进行首次定量跨平台评测。
result: Tactus 在 95% 置信度下最小可检测力为 0.59 N，比商用基线低 1.6–2.7 倍，跨参与者一致性达 0.87；在遮挡最严重的操作过程中，指尖关键点位姿跟踪相对误差为 11.0 mm。结合信号可支持物体属性估计、滑动检测和手物交互记录。
conclusion: Tactus 能以所需保真度采集接触感知操作策略和世界模型训练所需的演示数据，并提供平台、校准流程与标准化基准，推动灵巧操作数据采集的可比较评估。

title: GradSplat: Gradients Inside the Forward Pass for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting predicts a scene from a few images, but our predictor is less accurate than its own Gaussians optimized per scene on those images. This gap lies mostly in the shape of the Gaussians, their scale and rotation, since optimizing the shape alone recovers almost all of it and opacity and color recover less. Gradient steps on the input views correct this shape, and the model holds these views at inference. Log-anisotropy correction changes the axis ratios of each Gaussian in log space at constant volume, and in-forward gradient refinement renders the Gaussians into the input views and applies the gradient of the photometric loss with a learned recurrent update, first to opacity and color and then to the shape. GradSplat is a feed-forward model that refines its own Gaussians by learned gradient steps inside its forward pass, with no target view. On both complete six-view RealEstate10K protocols, it has the best PSNR and SSIM among nine methods and keeps its accuracy from $6$ to $42$ input views. Without fine-tuning, it is the most accurate on DL3DV and has the best PSNR and SSIM on ScanNet++. The code will be released at https://github.com/Jingong-Chen/GradSplat/.
tldr: GradSplat在前向传播中通过可学习梯度步细化自身3D高斯，无需目标视图即可提升少视图重建精度。
motivation: 前馈3D高斯泼溅能从少量图像预测场景，但精度仍低于逐场景优化的高斯，且差距主要来自高斯的尺度与旋转（形状），不透明度与颜色贡献较小。
method: 方法引入对数各向异性校正，在恒定体积下调整高斯轴比；并在前向传播中把高斯渲染到输入视图，用光度损失梯度经学习到的循环更新先修正不透明度与颜色、再修正形状，无需目标视图。
result: 在RealEstate10K两个完整六视图协议上，GradSplat在九种方法中取得最佳PSNR和SSIM，并在6至42个输入视图下保持精度；无需微调时在DL3DV上最准确，在ScanNet++上取得最佳PSNR和SSIM。
conclusion: 结果表明将学习到的梯度细化嵌入前馈过程可缩小与逐场景优化的差距，并提升跨数据集与视图数变化的泛化能力；代码将开源。

title: PT$^3$: Prototype-Guided Self-Supervised Pretraining for Generalizable mmWave Human Point Cloud Representation
abstract: Multi-source millimeter-wave (mmWave) observations offer an opportunity to learn human representations reusable across sensing tasks. However, sparse detections and multipath effects make these observations unstable, challenging existing point cloud pretraining methods. We propose PT$^3$, a prototype-guided self-supervised pretraining framework for mmWave human point clouds. PT$^3$ represents local states in spatial regions as sparse compositions of shared prototypes and learns their temporal evolution through autoregressive prediction. Observation consistency further stabilizes representations under radar perturbations. After pretraining on unlabeled sequences from multiple sources, the same frozen encoder supports action classification, dense point generation, joint pose estimation, and future motion prediction on datasets not used for pretraining. Across these tasks, PT$^3$ outperforms the compared pretraining baselines and achieves competitive or superior performance to task-specific models.
tldr: PT³ 利用原型引导的自监督预训练提升毫米波人体点云跨任务泛化能力。
motivation: 毫米波观测稀疏且受多径效应影响而不稳定，现有点云预训练方法难以直接适用；研究旨在从多源无标注毫米波人体点云中学习可跨传感任务复用的通用人体表示。
method: PT³ 将空间区域局部状态表示为共享原型的稀疏组合，并通过自回归预测学习其时间演化；同时引入观测一致性约束以在雷达扰动下稳定表示。预训练使用多源无标注序列，冻结编码器可直接支持动作分类、稠密点生成、关节姿态估计和未来运动预测。
result: 在未参与预训练的数据集上，PT³ 在动作分类、稠密点生成、关节姿态估计和未来运动预测四类任务上均优于对比的预训练基线，并达到与任务专用模型相当或更优的性能；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: PT³ 表明原型引导的自监督预训练能够从稀疏、不稳定的毫米波点云中学习可泛化的人体表示，并以单一冻结编码器支持多种下游任务，为多源毫米波人体感知提供了统一预训练范式。

title: Volley3D: Unified 3D Full-Sequence Reconstruction from Monocular Broadcasts
abstract: 3D reconstruction from single-view sports broadcast is a pivotal capability for automated analytics and immersive AR/VR replays, yet notoriously ill-posed due to difficult-to-calibrate moving cameras and depth ambiguity. Unlike widely studied racket sports, team sports such as volleyball feature unpredictable multi-contact sequences and high altitude jumps. These dynamics categorically invalidate the standard planar projection assumptions relied upon by existing methods. To resolve these limitations without 3D training supervision, we propose a complete, physics-grounded pipeline tailored to monocular broadcast volleyball. First, we include a correction module to the perspective drift induced by ground-plane projection by coupling temporal jump spotting with Newtonian interpolation for 3D player placement. Second, for 3D ball trajectory estimation, we design a dedicated sub-trajectory segmentation architecture alongside a collision-matching algorithm. By anchoring physical equations to reconstructed 3D hand vertices, we lift noisy ball 2D detections into a spatiotemporally coherent 3D scene. Evaluations on multi-camera benchmarks demonstrate our approach significantly reduces 3D spatial drift compared to 2D-reprojection baselines.
tldr: 提出无3D监督的物理约束流程，从单目排球转播中重建球员与球的统一3D全序列。
motivation: 单目体育转播的3D重建受移动相机难标定和深度歧义困扰，而排球等团队运动存在不可预测的多触点序列与高空跳跃，使现有方法依赖的平面投影假设失效。研究旨在无需3D训练监督的情况下解决单目排球转播的统一3D全序列重建问题。
method: 针对地面平面投影导致的透视漂移，引入结合时序跳跃检测与牛顿插值的校正模块以完成3D球员定位；针对3D球轨迹估计，设计子轨迹分割架构与碰撞匹配算法，并将物理方程锚定到重建的3D手部顶点，把噪声2D球检测提升为时空一致的3D场景。
result: 在多相机基准上，该方法相较2D重投影基线显著降低3D空间漂移；摘要未提供具体量化数值。
conclusion: 该工作提出面向单目排球转播的完整物理驱动流程，无需3D训练监督即可实现球员与球的统一3D全序列重建，有望服务自动分析与沉浸式AR/VR回放，并可推广至其他复杂团队运动。

title: Aligning Misaligned Benchmarks for Single-View Novel View Synthesis
abstract: While single-view novel view synthesis methods have been dramatically enhanced recently, how to quantify their performance has yet to be standardized. In this work, we demonstrate that an important factor lies in how each method's own reference frame is aligned with the so-called ground-truth pose. Existing methods often rely on test-time optimization of target poses for this alignment, which inherently is ill-posed due to the complexity of the optimization landscape of camera poses vs render accuracy, leading to methods being evaluated at an arbitrary local optimum. Some recognize this limitation and thus rely on 3D reconstructions of entire scenes using training and test views to align poses, which may be infeasible. In this work, instead, we propose to use traditional 2D-to-2D and 2D-to-3D image matching techniques to align 3D reconstructions. We also evaluate only within co-visible regions, between different views, which is the only place where a `correct' ground truth can be defined. Our evaluations show that with proper coordinate alignment, novel-view synthesis methods that use explicit 3D Gaussians achieve the state of the art, despite being previously reported in the literature to be outperformed by pure image-based 2D methods. We further provide a simple baseline that directly utilizes an off-the-shelf video generator and a feed-forward geometry estimator. Our simple baseline is already comparable to state-of-the-art methods specifically trained for novel-view synthesis, without any task-specific training.
tldr: 提出用2D-2D/2D-3D图像匹配对齐重建坐标系并仅在共视区域评测，修正单视图新视角合成基准。
motivation: 单视图新视角合成性能提升显著，但评测尚未标准化，关键问题在于各方法参考系与所谓真值位姿的对齐。现有测试时位姿优化本身病态，易停在任意局部最优；利用训练与测试视图重建全场景来对齐位姿也可能不可行。
method: 该工作采用传统2D-to-2D与2D-to-3D图像匹配技术对齐3D重建，并仅在视图间共视区域内评测，因为只有该区域能定义可靠的“正确”真值。
result: 正确坐标对齐后，使用显式3D Gaussians的新视角合成方法达到SOTA，尽管文献此前报告其被纯图像2D方法超越；作者还给出直接使用现成视频生成器和前馈几何估计器的简单基线，无需任务特定训练即与专用SOTA方法相当。
conclusion: 评测中的坐标对齐会显著影响方法排序，论文贡献了更可靠的基准对齐与共视评测思路，并提供了有竞争力的免训练简单基线，提示后续工作应重视标准化评测。

title: BudSplat: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting under a Rendering Budget
abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting has recently emerged as a promising alternative to per-scene optimization, enabling fast novel view synthesis by predicting Gaussian primitives directly from input images. However, it quickly faces a bottleneck of rendering efficiency while scaling from sparse to dense multi-view inputs, which offer more geometric constraints but produce a rapidly growing set of candidate Gaussians. Existing solutions cannot reliably distinguish redundant primitives, leading to many redundant primitives from repeatedly observed regions and increased rendering cost without much gain in visual quality. We propose BudSplat, a compact feed-forward 3DGS framework that learns to keep the most valuable Gaussians under a limited primitive count. BudSplat has two novel designs. The first is a detail-aware importance score that is extracted from multi-level visual tokens, providing an explicit cue for regions where pruning is likely to harm perceptual quality. The score can be injected into voxel fusion to preserve high-value local contributors during multi-view aggregation. The second is quality-aware Gaussian pruning that selects a compact set of primitives by jointly considering rendering contribution and detail importance. The quality-aware pruning enables local quota redistribution that helps avoid over-allocating primitives to large redundant regions. Experiments on RE10K, DL3DV, and ACID show that BudSplat achieves a favorable trade-off among rendering quality and efficiency.
tldr: BudSplat 在有限高斯基元预算下学习保留高价值高斯，实现前馈 3DGS 的渲染质量与效率权衡。
motivation: 前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting 从稀疏到稠密多视角输入扩展时，重复观测区域会产生大量冗余高斯基元，现有方法难以可靠区分冗余基元，导致渲染成本上升而视觉质量收益有限。为此需要在有限基元数量下保留最有价值的高斯。
method: 提出 BudSplat 紧凑前馈 3DGS 框架，包含细节感知重要性评分和质量感知高斯剪枝。细节感知评分从多级视觉 token 中提取并注入体素融合以保留高价值局部贡献；质量感知剪枝联合考虑渲染贡献与细节重要性选择紧凑基元，并通过局部配额重分配避免向大冗余区域过度分配。
result: 在 RE10K、DL3DV 和 ACID 数据集上的实验表明，BudSplat 在渲染质量与效率之间取得了有利权衡。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: BudSplat 通过显式建模细节重要性和质量感知剪枝，在有限高斯基元预算下提升前馈 3DGS 的紧凑性与渲染效率。其贡献在于为稠密多视角输入下的冗余基元控制提供了可学习方案，并有望推动高效前馈新视角合成。
